title: Proactive Executive Assistant — Save Me Time (Gig → Part-Time → Full-Time)
description:
Proactive Executive Assistant — Save Me Time (Gig → Part-Time → Full-Time)



About the role:

I'm a startup founder and full-time airline pilot — I move fast, think big-picture, and generate ideas faster than I can execute them. I need one proactive EA whose whole job is to save me time: take my scattered voice notes, turn them into action, chase me for what's missing, and get things done without me managing the process. This starts as a flexible gig and grows into part-time, then full-time, as we learn to work together. You'll primarily support me, occasionally my wife (a dental specialist in a demanding residency) with her scheduling/admin.



What you'll do:



Turn my daily voice memos/Slack brain-dumps into a clear task list in Asana

Flag what's missing and send me a short, specific ask (e.g., "Need: shipping address for T3 samples")

Own a single "Waiting on Abraham" list — nothing gets dropped

Weekly 15-min sync — read back priorities, I confirm/reprioritize

Handle simple recurring tasks yourself (renders, file org, scheduling) — you execute, not just organize

We will communicate through text and voice notes to tackle all the different tasks



Who you are:



Highly organized, calm under a fast pace

Comfortable managing up — chases me for answers I owe you

Trustworthy with sensitive info

title: Social Media Content & Repurposing VA:  Coaching/Podcast Brand (Part-Time, Room to Grow)
description:
About Me

I'm Janna Holterman, a Cardiac ICU nurse turned mindset and emotional healing coach and trained intuitive. I help high-achieving women who look like they have it all together (the career, the certifications, the house, the relationship) but still feel numb, empty, or like something's missing. I teach from the intersection of neuroscience, psychology, emotional processing, intuition and energy healing. My podcast, Unlocking Your More: with Janna Holterman, and my Instagram/TikTok content are where most people first find me I post everything under my own name/personal brand.

I'm looking for a Social Media Content Assistant to help me turn the content I already have (podcast episodes, past posts, raw video/audio) into fresh, scroll-stopping posts and Reels and to help move the right people from "just scrolling" into my world: listening to the podcast, signing up for my free training, or exploring a paid offer.

This is a part-time, remote, long-term role starting at 6 hours/week, with room to grow in hours and responsibility as we build trust and you show me what you can do.



What You'll Be Doing

Content repurposing (the core of the role)

Turn podcast episodes (audio and video) into short-form clips for Instagram Reels and TikToks,  finding the strongest hooks, moments, and quotes

Edit clips with captions/subtitles, clean cuts, and a consistent, on-brand look and feel

Repurpose existing content (past posts, podcast transcripts, quotes, testimonials) into new static posts, carousels, and Stories

Write captions and hooks that sound like me: direct, warm, no-fluff, and rooted in real teaching, not generic motivational quotes

Driving the right action

Every piece of content should point toward one of three outcomes: listening to the podcast, signing up for my free training (Regulated AF or a free monthly webinar), or learning about a paid offer

Build simple, consistent calls-to-action into captions, Stories, and video end cards

Help maintain a content calendar so posting stays consistent

Content organization

Keep an organized library of raw footage, edited clips, graphics, and captions so content is easy to find and reuse

Flag which older podcast episodes or posts have the strongest potential for repurposing

(This role may grow to include light community engagement replying to comments/DMs, engagement pods, or basic analytics tracking as hours increase.)



Who I'm Looking For

Must-haves:

Proven experience repurposing long-form content (podcast, YouTube, webinars) into short-form social content please include samples or a portfolio link

Comfortable editing video independently in tools like CapCut, Premiere Pro, Descript, or similar (you should already have a workflow this isn't a role where I'll be training someone on the basics of editing)

Strong eye for hooks you understand why the first 1-3 seconds of a Reel/TikTok either stops the scroll or loses it

Confident, clear written English for captions and copy

Experience with Canva (or similar) for static posts and carousels

Self-starter who can take a pile of raw content and turn it into a week's worth of posts with minimal hand-holding

Reliable, communicative, and comfortable with async work and weekly check-ins

Nice-to-haves (not required, but a bonus):

Familiarity with the coaching, wellness, mindset, or personal development space

Experience with
 marketing platforms or funnels (since one of the goals of this role is growing my
 list)

Basic understanding of Instagram/TikTok algorithm best practices and current trends/audio

Experience writing hooks or captions for a personal brand (not just a business/product brand)



Schedule & Compensation

Hours: Starting at 6 hours/week, with strong potential to grow into more hours (and more responsibility) for the right person

Rate: $6–$9 USD/hour, depending on experience and skill level to be discussed during the interview

Schedule: Mostly asynchronous/flexible you manage your own time to hit weekly deliverables, with one short weekly check-in call

Type: Independent contractor, long-term ongoing role if it’s a strong fit



How to Apply

To help me find the right person quickly, please apply with:

Your resume or a short intro about your relevant experience



2–3 examples of content you've repurposed before and after (e.g., "here's the podcast clip, here's the Reel I made from it") or a portfolio/social link showing your editing and caption work



A one-line answer to this question in your application: "What's one thing that makes you stop scrolling on a Reel or TikTok and want to click to learn more from someone?"



To confirm you've read this whole posting, please start your application message with the word "Intuition" in the subject line and tell me about an adversity you’ve overcome and how it made you stronger. Applications without this will not be reviewed.

I'm excited to find someone who gets genuinely excited about turning raw content into scroll-stopping posts and who wants to grow with me long-term.

title: Outbound Sales & Content Virtual Assistant – Employer Partnerships
description:
Respectable Results is a U.S.-based workforce development company. We help employers address hiring and workforce needs while helping job seekers connect with employment opportunities.



We are looking for a confident, persistent, resourceful Virtual Assistant who can help us grow employer partnerships, schedule discovery calls, create professional social media content, and eventually conduct employer discovery calls independently.



This is NOT a basic administrative VA position.



A major part of this role involves speaking with U.S. employers. You must be comfortable picking up the phone, getting past gatekeepers, speaking with hiring managers and HR professionals, handling objections, following up consistently, and turning conversations into scheduled meetings.



We are looking for someone who can think independently, solve problems, and take initiative, not someone who needs step-by-step instructions every time something does not go according to plan.



Primary Responsibilities:



Employer Outreach & Appointment Setting



Make outbound calls to U.S. employers during Central Time business hours.

Contact hiring managers, HR professionals, recruiters, business owners, and other decision-makers.

Learn about employers' current hiring and workforce needs.

Schedule qualified discovery calls.

Confidently navigate receptionists and gatekeepers.

Handle common objections professionally.

Conduct persistent but professional follow-up by phone and
.

Research employers before and after calls when appropriate.

Identify companies that may be actively hiring.

Find alternative contacts when the original contact is unavailable.

Maintain organized notes, statuses, contact information, and follow-up dates.

Track outreach activity and results.

Work toward weekly outreach, conversation, follow-up, and appointment-setting goals.

You must be comfortable hearing “no,” “not interested,” “send me something,” or “they're unavailable” without becoming discouraged.

When one method does not work, we expect you to think about what you can try next.



Discovery Calls & Employer Relationship Development



Initially, your primary responsibility will be getting qualified employers onto discovery calls with company leadership.

As you learn our company, services, messaging, and employer partnership model, you may be trained to lead discovery calls yourself.



This may include:

Asking employers questions about hiring challenges.

Identifying recruitment and retention problems.

Learning what positions employers are struggling to fill.

Identifying pain points and workforce needs.

Determining whether an employer is a good partnership opportunity.

Explaining appropriate company services.

Handling basic objections and questions.

Establishing clear next steps.

Documenting the employer's needs and follow-up requirements.

Maintaining relationships with prospective employer partners.

There is an opportunity for this position to grow into a larger business development and employer partnership role.



Social Media & Content Creation



This position will also assist with creating and scheduling content.

Responsibilities may include:

Create professional static social media graphics.

Turn existing photos, videos, information, and ideas into branded content.

Edit short-form videos and Reels.

Add captions, hooks, text overlays, transitions, music, and calls-to-action when appropriate.

Use Canva and/or similar graphic-design platforms.

Follow an established brand style.

Repurpose existing content into multiple posts.

Schedule approved content on platforms such as Instagram,
, and LinkedIn.

Organize photos, videos, graphics, and other media assets.

Make basic edits to presentations and marketing materials when needed.

You do not need to be a professional graphic designer, but your work should look polished, modern, clean, and appropriate for a professional U.S. business.



Sales, Marketing & Business Development Support



Additional responsibilities may include:

Research potential employer partners.

Build targeted employer prospect lists.

Research companies before discovery calls.

Identify the appropriate hiring or HR contact.

Research open positions and hiring activity.

Update employer outreach trackers or CRM records.

Draft follow-up
s.

Prepare information before meetings.

Update simple sales presentations.

Track employer partnership opportunities.

Identify potential community partners.

Research networking and business-development opportunities.

Maintain organized records of outreach campaigns.

Provide weekly reports on activity, results, challenges, and opportunities.



Who We Are Looking For



You may be a strong fit if you are:

Very confident speaking on the phone.

Persistent without being rude or overly aggressive.

Comfortable initiating conversations with people you do not know.

Comfortable speaking with U.S. business owners, HR professionals, hiring managers, recruiters, and executives.

Able to speak clear, polished, easy-to-understand professional English.

Experienced with cold calling, warm calling, telesales, appointment setting, recruitment, business development, or lead generation.

Able to think independently.

A strong problem solver.

Comfortable making decisions within your responsibilities.

Someone who looks for another solution when the first option does not work.

Highly dependable.

Excellent with follow-up.

Comfortable being held accountable for measurable results.

Organized enough to manage multiple employer leads and follow-ups.

Able to write professional
s in English.

Comfortable using Canva.

Capable of basic short-form video editing.

Comfortable learning new software and AI tools.

Able to research information online efficiently.

Able to receive feedback and improve quickly.

Comfortable working independently without constant supervision.

Experience in recruitment, staffing, HR, workforce development, B2B sales, U.S. call-center operations, appointment setting, or business development is strongly preferred.



Technical Requirements

You must have:

Reliable high-speed internet.

Reliable computer.

Quality headset.

Quiet professional environment for employer calls.

Reliable availability during agreed work hours.

Ability to work during at least a portion of U.S. Central Time business hours.

Experience with any of the following is helpful:

Canva

CapCut or similar video-editing software

Google Workspace

Microsoft Office

CRM systems

Social media scheduling platforms

Business phone systems or dialers

LinkedIn

Meta Business Suite

AI tools such as ChatGPT



Compensation

Starting Pay: $3–$5 USD per hour depending on experience, skills, and demonstrated ability.

This position also includes opportunities for performance bonuses ($10USD per successful outcome)



Bonuses may be earned based on outcomes such as:

Successful employer partnerships.

Employer relationships that lead to successful hiring outcomes.

Other measurable revenue-producing results.

We are interested in rewarding people who help create real business results — not simply someone who completes a list of tasks.



Strong performance can lead to:

Increased compensation.

Additional bonuses.

Increased hours.

Greater responsibility.

Leading discovery calls.

Expanded business-development responsibilities.

Long-term growth within the company.



HOW TO APPLY



Please do not send a generic application.



To be considered, please answer ALL of the questions below in your application message.



**1. Voice Introduction**

Send a link to a 60–90 second audio or video introduction. Tell us your name, your previous outbound calling or appointment-setting experience, who you have called in previous roles, and why you are good at getting decision-makers to speak with you.



**2. Gatekeeper Scenario**

You are calling a U.S.-based company to learn about its hiring needs and schedule a business discovery call.



The receptionist asks:



“What exactly are you calling about?”



Write exactly what you would say.



**4. Problem-Solving Scenario**

You have called an employer three times. The hiring manager has not returned your calls, but you know the company is actively hiring.



What would you do next? Be specific.



**5. Discovery Call Scenario**

A business owner tells you:



“We’re having trouble hiring people, and when we do hire them, they don’t stay very long.”



What five questions would you ask before recommending a solution?



**6. Independence Question**

Tell us about a time when something went wrong while completing a task and, instead of immediately asking your manager what to do, you found another way to complete it.



Tell us what happened, what you did, and the result.



**7. Portfolio**

Provide links to:



* 2–3 static social media graphics you personally created.

* At least 1 short-form video or Reel you personally edited.



**8. Experience**

Tell us which of the following you have experience with:

Canva, CapCut, CRM systems, Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn, social media scheduling tools, business phone systems/dialers, and AI tools.



**9. Availability**

Include:



* Your current location and time zone.

* Your available working hours.

* Whether you can make calls during U.S. Central Time business hours.

* Your requested hourly rate.

* Your preferred weekly hours.

description:
Job Overview:

We run a YouTube channel focused on GTA 5 content and are looking for someone who enjoys playing GTA 5 to record gameplay footage for us on a recurring basis. This is a simple, low-pressure role — you just need to play the game and show your face on camera while doing it. No editing, no scriptwriting, no voice commentary required.



What You'll Do:



Play GTA 5 for approximately 2 hours per session, once every alternate day



Record your face on camera for the entire duration of the gameplay (webcam overlay, similar to popular gameplay streamers)



At the very start of each recording, give a short 5-second intro in your own words — something like: "Hello, welcome! I'll be playing GTA and you'll learn XYZ about GTA. Let's start." (we'll tell you the topic/angle for each video if needed)



Play silently after the intro — no talking or commentary needed during the rest of the gameplay



Mute or disable any in-game audio/chat being picked up in the recording (we add our own voiceover afterward)



Upload/share the raw footage with us after each session (we'll provide the preferred method — Google Drive, etc.)



What We Provide:



Full creative freedom for gameplay — no fixed missions or objectives to hit, just natural gameplay



All editing, voiceover, and post-production handled by our team — you only need to deliver raw footage



Requirements:



Own a copy of GTA 5 (PC, PS4/PS5, or Xbox) and can play comfortably



Working webcam and decent recording setup (screen recording + face cam, synced)



Stable internet connection to upload footage regularly



Comfortable being on camera for extended periods



Reliable and consistent — able to deliver footage every alternate day without missing sessions



Basic English is fine — you'll only need to speak ~5 seconds per session



Schedule: Flexible, as long as footage is delivered every alternate day per the above schedule

title: B2B Appointment Setter — Cold Calling (Remote, US Hours)
description:
Book meetings for a marketing agency. $5/hr base + $20 per qualified booking. Full-time, remote, night shift.



We're a marketing agency that helps commercial vehicle wrap companies in the US get more customers. You'll cold call wrap shops across the US and book short intro meetings for our sales team. 



The role: 



Call US businesses from a list we provide

Follow our script, handle objections, book meetings on our calendar

Log every call outcome in our CRM

~20–45 dials per hour using our auto-dialer



Hours: 



Monday to Friday, 9:00 PM – 5:00 AM Philippine Time (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Eastern), with a 1-hour break. This is a night shift role. Work from home — no commute, no traffic, no transport costs.



Pay: 



$5 USD/hour base

$20 USD per qualified booking

Typical performance: 15–25 bookings/week = $500–700 USD/week

Paid biweekly



A booking counts as qualified when: you have the decision maker's name, they verbally confirmed the day and time, the business does commercial vehicle work, and the meeting is within 5 business days. 



What we provide: Leads, dialling software, phone numbers, CRM, script, and full training. No cost to you. 



You need: 



Clear, fluent English — US clients must understand you easily

Previous cold calling, appointment setting, or call center experience

Reliable internet, a quiet space, and a headset with a microphone that produces clear voice quality

To be comfortable with rejection and high call volume



How to apply: 



Send all three of these together. Applications missing any part will not be reviewed.



A voice recording (60 seconds, English). Say your name, where you're based, and describe one cold calling job you've had — what you sold and roughly how many meetings you booked per week. 

One or two sentences on why you want this role and why you think you will succeed. 

Your CV or a link to your profile. 



What happens next: 



We review your recording. 

15-minute video call in English. 

Recorded mock cold call — we'll send you the script 24 hours before. 

30-day paid trial begins. 



We reply to every applicant who completes all three steps. Expect to hear back within 3 business days.

title: Social Media Manager + B2B Outreach Specialist (Restoration Company - US Based)
description:
ABOUT US



RestoraMax is a 24/7 water, fire, and mold restoration company based in Bowie, Maryland. When a pipe bursts or a house floods, we're on site in 45 minutes, we help the homeowner file their insurance claim, and we stay with them from cleanup through rebuild.



Most of our work comes from referrals — plumbers, septic companies, insurance agents, and property managers who run into water damage before we do. We pay $1,000 minimum for every referral that turns into a job, paid same day, no contract and no minimums.



Our problem is simple: there are hundreds of these businesses in Maryland who don't know we exist yet. That's your job.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



About 60% of your week is outreach:

- Build and maintain a target list of plumbers, HVAC companies, septic/cesspool companies, property managers, and insurance agents across Maryland (Bowie, Annapolis, Upper Marlboro, Silver Spring, PG County, Anne Arundel County, and surrounding areas)

- Send personalized DMs and messages on Instagram,
, and LinkedIn — not copy-paste spam, actual messages that reference their business

- Follow up consistently with everyone who doesn't reply the first time (most of your wins will come from follow-up #3, not #1)

- Book interested partners onto a call with the owner — you are not expected to close the deal, you are expected to start the conversation and get it to a phone call

- Track every contact, message, reply, and outcome in a spreadsheet/CRM so we always know where each partner stands



About 40% is social media:

- Manage our Instagram and
 — post 4-5x per week using job site photos and videos our field crew sends in

- Write captions that sound like a restoration contractor, not a marketing agency

- Reply to comments and DMs, including emergency inquiries (you'll route real leads straight to our dispatch line)

- Engage daily with local Maryland contractor and real estate accounts so our name keeps showing up in their notifications

- Keep a simple content calendar so we're never scrambling for something to post



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



In your first 90 days: a clean target list of 300+ Maryland businesses, 50+ new outreach conversations started per week, and at least 4-6 referral partner calls booked per month. Our social accounts posting consistently without me having to chase you for it.



REQUIREMENTS



- Excellent written English — you'll be messaging American business owners directly and it has to read like a real person

- Experience with cold outreach or appointment setting (DM outreach, LinkedIn,
 — any of it)

- Comfortable with Instagram,
, and LinkedIn as business tools, not just personal accounts

- Organized. You will be tracking hundreds of contacts and following up on schedule. If you lose track of people, this job doesn't work

- Able to work US Eastern Time hours (roughly 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST)

- Reliable internet and a working computer

- Thick skin. Most people will ignore you. The ones who don't will make you a lot of money



NICE TO HAVE (not required)



- Experience with home services, construction, or contractor clients

- Canva or basic video editing (CapCut is fine)

- Experience with a CRM



WHAT WE OFFER



- Stable full-time role with a real US company, paid on time every time

- $100 bonus for every referral partner you sign — this is uncapped, and our partners can each be worth tens of thousands of dollars to us

- Paid time off and a raise review at 6 months

- Direct access to the owner. No layers of management, no agency politics

- Long-term role. I'm looking for someone to grow with this business, not a 3-month contractor



HOW TO APPLY



Please do these three things or your application will be skipped:



1. Start your application with the word "BOWIE" so I know you read the whole post.

2. Write me a sample DM (3-4 sentences) that you would send to a plumbing company in Maryland to get them interested in our referral program.

3. Tell me about a time you got someone to respond after they ignored your first message. What did you do differently?



Include any links to social accounts you've managed if you have them. I read every application personally and I reply to the ones that follow instructions.

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer | Build Trusted Transfer Platform MVP | Anti-Exploitation Mission

Start your application with the phrase: "TRUSTFARE BUILDER"



Include:

extension of our marketing team.

- Reliable, fast communicator with good written English

**Pay**



- Paid test project first: $20 for one test reel using our real footage

**How to Apply**



1. Send 3-5 links to your best short-form work (Reels or TikToks). Hospitality, travel, or Airbnb examples get priority.

title: GoHighLevel Operations & Business Assistant
description:
About the role



I run a membership community for clinic owners — chiropractors, physios, massage therapists — across the UK, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, and the USA. The business is growing and I need a reliable right-hand person to handle the operational side so I can stay focused on content, strategy, and growing the community.



This is not a basic data entry role. You will be working inside GoHighLevel every day — building pipelines, setting up automations, managing contacts, and keeping the business running. You will also manage our community platform (Circle) and handle daily admin, scheduling, and communication via Slack.



If you know GoHighLevel well, you're organised, and you like systems — this role is for you.



What you'll do



GoHighLevel — the core of the role



Upload
s I write and schedule them to the list

Build and manage automation sequences and pipelines — including a follow-up sequence for leads who don't convert within the 7-day window

Set up new sub-accounts in GHL when members request GoHighLevel access

Manage contacts — tagging, pipeline stages, keeping records clean

Monitor automations and flag anything not working correctly



Community (Circle)



Manage the migration of our existing community from Skool to Circle — inviting members, sending instructions, tracking who has moved, chasing anyone who hasn't

Welcome every new member when they join

Monitor Circle daily for unanswered posts and flag anything that needs a response

Keep the community tidy and organised



Content and Social Media



Upload content I create and schedule it across social media platforms

Simple video edits — trimming, captioning, cutting longer videos into short clips (CapCut or similar)

Maintain a content tracker so nothing gets missed or double-posted



Daily Operations



Send a daily Slack briefing every morning before 9am UK time: 3 things that need my attention today, what's scheduled to go out, anything outstanding

Manage my shared inbox in GHL — flag messages that need my response, handle simple admin replies

General admin tasks as they come up — file organisation, updating trackers, keeping things running



What you won't do



Write content or copy — that comes from me

Speak to members or clients directly

Make decisions without checking with me first



What I need from you



Proven GoHighLevel experience — non-negotiable. You must have built pipelines and automations before, not just uploaded contacts or sent
s

Experience managing an
 list — scheduling broadcasts, building sequences

Familiar with Circle or a similar community platform

Basic video editing (CapCut or equivalent)

Slack — you will use this every day for communication and daily briefings

Reliable, fast internet and consistent availability — you must be able to send the daily briefing before 9am UK time

Strong attention to detail

Someone who asks when unsure rather than guesses



Shortlisted candidates will be given a short practical GoHighLevel test before being hired. This is how I confirm you can do what you say. Please only apply if you are confident completing a live task in GHL.



Hours and pay



15–20 hours per week to start, with potential to grow as the business grows. Rate based on experience — please include your expected hourly rate in your application.



This is a long-term role. I am not looking for someone for a month.



How to apply



Start your application with the word CLINIC — applications that don't start with this will not be read.



Then tell me:



Your GoHighLevel experience — have you built pipelines and automations? Give me a specific example of what you built and what it did

One role where you managed someone else's content or operations

Your expected hourly rate

Your availability and what time you would be able to send a daily Slack message before 9am UK time



Practical Test (for shortlisted candidates)



Send this to candidates you want to assess before hiring:



"Please complete the following task in a GHL demo account or your own sub-account and send me a short Loom showing what you built:



1. Create a pipeline called 'New Lead' with three stages: Loom Sent, Followed Up, Converted

2. Set up an automation that triggers when a contact is moved to the 'Followed Up' stage and sends them an
 24 hours later with the subject line 'Just checking in'

3. Add one SMS step 48 hours after the



This should take you no more than 20–30 minutes if you know GHL well."



Anyone who can't complete that cleanly isn't the right hire.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
# 🌟 Executive & Personal Assistant



We are seeking an exceptional **Executive & Personal Assistant** to support an entrepreneur across a growing portfolio of businesses, emerging ventures, and personal priorities. This is a **high-trust role** for someone who can create clarity, maintain momentum, protect the owner’s time, and make sure important commitments move forward.  



The right person will do more than complete assigned tasks. You should be resourceful, highly organized, adaptable, comfortable learning quickly, and able to bring structure to unfamiliar situations. You’ll help the owner stay focused on leadership, revenue, growth, relationships, and new opportunities. 🚀 



## 🎯 The Purpose of This Role



Your primary responsibility is to reduce the **administrative, organizational, coordination, research, and follow-up workload** surrounding the business owner.



Success means the owner spends less time tracking, reminding, organizing, scheduling, researching, and following up — and more time **leading and building.** ✨ 



## 📋 What You’ll Help With



### 📅 Executive Calendar & Priorities



* Manage business and personal calendars

* Coordinate meetings, appointments, calls, events, property visits, and travel

* Identify scheduling conflicts and missing preparation time

* Prepare concise briefings covering priorities, deadlines, appointments, and decisions

* Keep postponed or deprioritized work visible for appropriate follow-up 



### 📧 Inbox & Communications



* Organize and triage business and personal communications

* Draft polished
s, messages, responses, and follow-ups

* Learn and accurately reflect the owner’s communication style

* Flag communications requiring a decision, approval, or sensitive response

* Follow up with employees, vendors, clients, partners, contractors, advisors, and other contacts

* Handle correspondence with discretion 🔐 



### 📝 Meetings & Follow-Up



* Prepare agendas, background information, documents, and decision points

* Record decisions, action items, owners, and deadlines

* Track follow-ups and completion

* Escalate delays, risks, or missing information before they become urgent

* Turn lengthy information into concise summaries and recommended next steps 



### 📊 Business & Project Coordination



* Maintain visibility across business priorities and new ventures

* Track projects, deadlines, dependencies, opportunities, and outstanding decisions

* Coordinate information between the owner, team members, VAs, contractors, and outside professionals

* Conduct research and prepare concise decision briefs

* Help organize new projects and unfamiliar business opportunities

* Ensure delegated work has a clear outcome, owner, deadline, and follow-up point 



### 💍 Bridal Business Support



* Support executive-level projects involving partnerships, recruiting, financing, marketing, and expansion

* Coordinate assigned deliverables with team members and external partners

* Organize documents, applications, agreements, and business information

* Help strategic initiatives move forward without unnecessarily pulling the owner back into routine operations 



### 🏡 Airbnb & Short-Term Rental Support



* Coordinate property appointments, vendors, maintenance, purchases, and documentation

* Track inspections, renewals, property tasks, deadlines, and outstanding issues

* Research properties, services, regulations, furnishings, pricing, and operational needs

* Organize property records and information 



### 🚀 New Ventures & Special Projects



* Research unfamiliar industries, opportunities, tools, competitors, and service providers

* Turn early-stage ideas into organized project plans

* Establish trackers, folders, timelines, contact lists, and administrative workflows

* Collect information needed for informed decisions

* Adapt as priorities and opportunities evolve 



### 🤝 Team & Delegation Support



* Serve as a reliable coordination point between the owner and her teams

* Route requests to the appropriate person

* Track delegated assignments and follow up

* Help prepare leadership meetings, hiring activities, performance conversations, and team communications

* Identify recurring work that could be delegated, documented, automated, or eliminated

* Help protect the owner from becoming the default person for routine questions 



### 🗂️ Systems & Information Management



* Keep information organized across
, calendars, cloud storage, project-management systems, and communication platforms

* Create and improve templates, trackers, checklists, and SOPs

* Use AI and automation tools responsibly to reduce manual administrative work 🤖

* Maintain reliable sources of truth for priorities, contacts, projects, and follow-ups 



## 🛠️ Skills & Qualifications



We are looking for someone with:



* ⭐ Experience supporting a founder, entrepreneur, executive, business owner, or other high-responsibility environment

* 🎯 Exceptional organization and attention to detail

* ✅ Excellent follow-through and ownership

* ✍️ Strong written communication

* 🧠 Sound judgment and ability to anticipate needs without overstepping authority

* 📊 Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

* 🔎 Strong research and problem-solving skills

* 🌱 Ability to learn unfamiliar industries quickly

* 💻 Proficiency with digital productivity, communication, calendar, and project-management tools

* 🤖 Comfort using AI tools to research, organize, draft, summarize, and streamline work

* 🔐 Strong discretion and confidentiality

* 💬 Calm, professional communication — including the confidence to respectfully redirect a busy executive when necessary 



## ✨ You May Be a Great Fit If You...



Naturally notice what needs to happen next and enjoy creating order from many moving pieces.



You can move between different business and personal priorities without losing context, communicate clearly, work independently, and keep the owner appropriately informed.



Most importantly, you understand **when to act, when to recommend, and when to ask.** You build trust through discretion, accuracy, consistency, adaptability, and follow-through. 🌟 



## 🔐 Trust, Judgment & Boundaries



This role comes with meaningful responsibility, but good judgment includes knowing where your authority ends.



You will be trusted to organize, coordinate, research, draft, remind, and follow up within approved guidelines. Significant financial commitments, legal or financial decisions, hiring or compensation decisions, partnerships, confidential disclosures, public statements, and changes to strategic priorities require appropriate approval. 



## 🌱 Why Join?



This is an opportunity to work closely with an entrepreneur across **multiple businesses and emerging ventures**. The position offers meaningful responsibility, varied industry exposure, and the opportunity to grow into a trusted long-term partnership. 



## 🚀 HOW TO APPLY — IMPORTANT



📌 **All applicants must complete our official Executive & Personal Assistant application form to be considered.**



👉 **APPLY HERE:**

**
**



📝 Please complete the application carefully and provide **all requested information**, including your resume and answers to the role-specific questions.



⚠️ **Submitting an application or sending a message through OnlineJobs.ph alone does not complete your application. You must submit the application form above to be considered for the position.**

title: SAM.gov Procurement Specialist & RFQ/RFP Compliance Expert
description:
Company:  Confidential / Growing U.S. Federal Contractor



Industry:** Commercial Construction & Government Lodging / Corporate Housing



 

Job Overview:

We are a rapidly growing U.S. federal contractor operating in commercial construction and corporate/government lodging solutions. We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Procurement & Strategic Outreach Specialist for a 30 to 35-hour-per-week role.

This role requires a unique hybrid skill set: You must be analytical enough to manage our 
 pipeline and shred complex federal RFPs, but confident enough to pick up the phone and stand behind your research. You will act as our primary opportunity scout, compliance gatekeeper, and initial point of contact for prime contractors. You do the heavy lifting and vetting so our executive team only steps in for fully qualified, legitimate opportunities.

What We Expect (No Hand-Holding):

We are hiring a specialist, not a trainee. We expect you to already know how to navigate 
, map compliance requirements, and use GoHighLevel. We will provide the goals, the targets, and the resources, but we expect you to know how to execute them without being micromanaged

Core Responsibilities:**



Strategic Outreach & Verification:** You aren't just doing paperwork—you will make calls to prime contractors, project managers, and agencies to verify bid details, coordinate teaming agreements, and introduce our housing and construction capabilities based on the opportunities you've researched.



AI-Enhanced "Shredding" & Analysis:** Thoroughly read and extract requirements from Section L (Instructions to Offerors) and Section M (Evaluation Factors) to build comprehensive compliance checklists. We encourage the use of AI tools to speed up your workflow, but **you are the human expert**. You must verify, edit, and take total ownership of all AI output.





GoHighLevel (GHL) Management:** Must be highly proficient in GoHighLevel. You will use GHL daily to manage all leads, operate the internal phone system, and track our active pipelines.





Pipeline Management & Expansion:** Monitor 
 and other public procurement boards daily using our target NAICS codes. Research and integrate new NAICS and PSC codes as we continuously expand our offerings.





Document Assembly:** Prepare draft proposal packages, format past performance sheets, and coordinate capability statements.





Deadline Tracking:** Maintain a master pipeline spreadsheet, tracking all submission deadlines, Q&A cutoffs, and solicitation amendments (SF-30s).





Daily Syncs & Team Integration:** Participate in a daily 15-minute alignment meeting (as needed) and attend daily team meetings to ensure seamless communication and progress tracking.





Requirements:





Schedule & Time Zone Alignment:** Must be available to work 30 to 35 hours per week during U.S. Central Time (CDT/CST) business hours.



Tech Stack:** Must have some experience working inside GoHighLevel (GHL).



Exceptional Spoken English & Professional Confidence:** You must be highly proficient and comfortable making direct outbound phone calls to U.S.-based government agencies and corporate partners to verify your research and coordinate partnerships.

  



Demonstrated experience navigating 
, reading U.S. federal solicitations, and building compliance matrices.



Adaptable & Growth-Oriented Mindset:** We expect a proactive approach as we expand into new procurement strategies.



**Compensation & Pay Structure:**



Starting Pay:** $4.00 hour during your 30-day probationary period.



Post-60-Day Pay Increase:** Rate increases to $5.00 then  $6.00/hour after 90 days  , after 180 days $8 hr 



Performance & Team Bonuses: 



Submission Bonus:** $2.00 bonus for every approved, fully compliant contract package you successfully assemble and submit.



Contract Win Bonus:** $10.00 bonus for every contract successfully awarded to our firm.



Monthly Team KPI Bonus (Up to $75/month) based on the following metrics:**

* $25 for maintaining a 15-minute response time during designated lead-handling hours (with protected "deep work" time for RFP shredding).

* $25 for perfectly documenting and updating all pipelines in GHL.

* $25 for ensuring zero phone calls are missed from incoming leads (or ensuring prompt callbacks).







Health Stipend:** $30/month contribution toward your personal insurance/benefits after 90 days .



13th-Month Pay:** Awarded annually after 12 months of continuous employment.





To Apply, You Must Include the Following:

Please reply to this posting with the phrase  "
 Compliance"  in your subject line, and provide the following in your cover letter:



1. When you review a federal solicitation, what is your exact step-by-step process for requirement mapping between Section L and Section M?

2. Briefly describe the types of U.S. federal or corporate proposals you have actively supported in the past, and describe your experience using GoHighLevel.

3. A link to a short (1 to 2 minute) video or voice introduction.** Please introduce yourself, summarize your GovCon experience, and let us hear your communication style and phone confidence. (A simple Loom, Google Drive, or YouTube unlisted link is perfect).

title: HR - DTC ecom Brand

title: Creative & Growth Operations Manager - DTC Performance
description:
Summary

We are looking for a Creative & Growth Operations Manager to build and manage the operational foundation of a fast-growing DTC beauty brand primarily serving the US market.



This role will connect the full performance growth workflow across Creative Strategists, media buyers, copywriters, video editors, designers, UGC creators, CRO specialists, funnel builders, and retention specialist — ensuring that creative assets, advertorials, landing pages, offers, and retention initiatives move smoothly from strategy and brief through production, launch, performance review, and iteration.



We are looking for someone who is highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and experienced in building scalable systems inside a fast-moving DTC or performance marketing environment.



Key Responsibilities



- Manage the end-to-end workflow across performance creative, UGC production, advertorials, listicles, landing pages, PDPs, offer tests, and retention initiatives.

- Translate creative, CRO, and retention roadmaps into clear sprint plans with owners, priorities, dependencies, timelines, and deliverables.

- Coordinate between Creative Strategists, media buyers, copywriters, editors, designers, creators, CRO specialists, funnel builders, and retention partners.

- Ensure briefs and production requirements are complete before work begins, including formats, references, deliverables, deadlines, tracking requirements, and approval ownership.

- Manage creative and funnel timelines, production capacity, feedback, revisions, QA, approvals, asset organization, and launch readiness.

- Ensure that media-buying and conversion results are documented and fed back into creative, funnel, and retention planning for the next testing cycle.

- Build and continuously improve SOPs, ClickUp/Notion boards, trackers, dashboards, naming conventions, reporting systems, and team workflows.

- Identify bottlenecks, missed handoffs, unclear ownership, and repeated rework, then proactively improve the underlying process.

- Maintain clear accountability across the team and provide concise weekly updates covering what shipped, what is in progress, what is blocked, and what requires a decision.

- Help the team increase output and speed without sacrificing strategic quality or production standards.



Requirements



- 2+ years of experience in Creative Operations, Growth Operations, Creative Project Management, or Production Management.

- Direct experience working with DTC ecommerce brands, performance marketing teams, or direct-response creative agencies.

- Experience coordinating cross-functional teams involving Creative Strategists, media buyers, copywriters, video editors, designers, creators, CRO specialists, funnel builders, or retention teams.

- Strong understanding of the performance creative lifecycle, from research and briefs through production, launch, performance analysis, iteration, and learning documentation.

- Familiarity with direct-response funnels, including advertorials, listicles, pre-landers, landing pages, PDPs, offer testing, upsells, and conversion-focused copy.

- Demonstrated experience building SOPs, production systems, capacity trackers, approval workflows, and operational processes from scratch.

- Strong project management skills across multiple SKUs, campaigns, and concurrent workstreams.

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, reliable, and proactive, with strong ownership and follow-through.

- Comfortable working directly with founders and senior functional leads while maintaining clear responsibility across the wider team.

- Proficiency with ClickUp, Notion, Asana, Slack, Google Workspace, or similar project-management and documentation tools.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

s, route information to the correct client profiles, and ensure tasks are executed so nothing falls through the cracks.

eting (typically between 10:00 AM and 12:00 PM US Central Time) to align on the day's priorities.

 the incoming leads, answering their questions and expertly guiding them to book.

35 Hours Per Week.

Mandatory Daily Tea
etings:** You are required to attend a 1 to 2-hour video tea
eting **every single day that you work . These are critical, daily syncs where we discuss campaign performance, new visions, and upcoming system builds.

The 1-Week Paid Trial:** We are hiring within the next week. Your first week will be a paid trial at **$4.00 / Hour** to ensure you are the perfect fit for our ecosystem.

* **Month 1 (Including Trial):* $4.00 / Hour

* **Month 2:* $6.00 / Hour

* **After 90 Days:* $8.00 / Hour PLUS a $30/month stipend strictly to cover your local HMO health insurance costs.





Long-Term Loyalty Bonus:** After 12 months  of continuous, successful employment, you will receive a full  13th-month pay bonus.



Monthly KPI Bonuses:** You will receive additional  bonuses at the end of each month if your systems hit our expected lead-generation goals.

 Uncapped Commissions:** You earn bonuses for every lead you nurture that successfully closes/books!

 Example 1: You set up a roofing funnel and work the inbox. When we close and collect payment from the roof lead, you get $25

* *Example 2:  You build a retreat funnel and text the interested leads. When a lead pays and books the retreat, you get **$50

* *Example 3: You manage the funnel for our energy therapy and hypnosis sessions. Every session booked gets you an extra $10.







Who You Are:



Education / Certification Required:** You MUST hold a formal degree OR an official GoHighLevel Certification to be considered for this role.

 You have verifiable, hands-on experience building advanced funnels, fixing webhooks, managing custom code, and handling A2P compliance inside GoHighLevel.



Your written English is exceptional, and you know how to text/email leads in a friendly, professional, and persuasive way.



 You are an independent thinker. You don't wait to be told exactly what to do step-by-step.



How to Apply:

description:
AI AUTOMATION & AI CLONE ENGINEER

Full-Time Remote — Philippines



 $1,250–$2,000 USD/Month + Bonuses + Benefits + Technology Allowance



We are looking for **one exceptional AI builder** to join our team full-time and, ideally, stay with us for years.



**This is NOT a virtual assistant position.**



We are looking for someone who lives and breathes AI, automation, agents and emerging technology.



If you're constantly experimenting with new AI tools, building automations, figuring out how to make AI do work that normally requires people, and learning what's coming next — we want to talk to you.



## WE ARE LOOKING FOR A LONG-TERM TEAM MEMBER



This isn't a 3-month project.



We have **plenty of work today and a growing pipeline of AI projects for the future.**



We want to find someone exceptional, invest in them, give them great technology to work with, and build a relationship that can last **years and years.**



As our capabilities and client base grow, we want this person's responsibilities, skills and compensation to grow with us.



## YOUR FIRST MAJOR PROJECT: BUILD A COMPLETE AI CLONE



Your first major project will be helping us build a **complete, production-ready AI clone of our founder.**



Not simply a short AI-generated video.



We want a reusable system capable of generating convincing videos using his:



**Voice

Face and appearance

Speech

Lip synchronization

Natural movement

Presentation style**



Once built, we should be able to provide a newscript and generate professional AI videos without repeatedly recording the real person.



This isn't just an experiment.



We already have **5–6 clients ready for AI cloning**, and we expect this service to grow.



Your job will be to help us perfect the process and then make it repeatable for clients.



## AI CLONING IS ONLY PART OF THE JOB



We're building an AI automation company.



You'll also help create:



**AI agents

AI workflows

Business-process automations

24/7 AI workers

CRM automations

Lead-generation systems

Sales and marketing automations

Client onboarding systems

API integrations

Voice AI

AI video systems

Internal business automations**



We want someone who can look at a business problem and ask:



### "How can AI automate this?"



And then actually build it.



## TECHNOLOGY & EXPERIENCE



You don't need to know every tool below.



You DO need to be highly capable with several of them and able to learn new technology extremely quickly.



Experience with:



**OpenAI / OpenAI API

Claude / Anthropic

Gemini

OpenClaw

Hermes or comparable agent frameworks

n8n

Make

Zapier

APIs and webhooks

JSON

Python and/or JavaScript

AI agents

LLM workflows

Voice AI and voice cloning

AI avatars and video cloning

CRM automation**



Experience with ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Synthesia, Tavus, Captions or similar technologies is valuable.



**We care much more about what you've actually built than your degree or certificates.**



## COMPENSATION



### $1,250–$2,000 USD PER MONTH



Starting compensation will depend on demonstrated skill, experience and the quality of your work.



This is a **full-time, long-term position.**



In addition to base compensation, there are opportunities for **performance and project bonuses** as we successfully deploy systems for clients.



Exceptional people who create exceptional value will have opportunities to increase their compensation and responsibilities.



## BENEFITS & LONG-TERM INVESTMENT



We want someone who sees this as a **career opportunity**, not another short-term online job.



After successfully completing the probationary period, eligible team members will receive company-supported Philippine benefits, including:



**PhilHealth health coverage/contributions**



**SSS retirement/social-security contributions**



Additional benefit details, eligibility and company/employee contribution arrangements will be explained during the hiring process and structured in accordance with the applicable employment arrangement and Philippine requirements.



### UP TO $2,000 USD HIGH-PERFORMANCE LAPTOP



We also believe AI professionals need serious equipment.



After successfully completing your **first year with the company**, we will provide or fund an **ultra-high-performance laptop valued at up to $2,000 USD** for eligible full-time employees.



And this isn't intended to be a one-time benefit.



For employees who remain with the company and continue performing at a high level, we intend to provide a **technology refresh allowance of up to $2,000 after each subsequent completed year**, subject to company policy and equipment needs.



We want our AI team working with **excellent technology — not fighting outdated computers.**



## STABILITY



One of the biggest things we can offer the right person is **work.**



We aren't hiring because we have one project that needs to be completed.



We already have AI projects underway, clients waiting, automations to build, cloning projects to complete and considerably more coming.



### We have enough work to keep the right person busy for years.



We're looking for someone who wants to grow with us as AI changes — and potentially become one of the key technical people in our company.



## PAID FINALIST CHALLENGE



We don't want to hire someone simply because they interview well.



**We want to see what you can actually build.**



Selected finalists will be offered a:



### $75 USD PAID AI CLONING CHALLENGE



We will provide approved source video and audio of our founder.



Your assignment will be to create a **usable AI video + voice clone system** within the agreed scope.



We're not looking for a 15-second trick or filter.



We're evaluating whether you understand how to create a **repeatable AI cloning system capable of producing new content.**



You choose the technology.



Be prepared to explain:



**What tools you selected and why

How the system works

What it costs to operate

Approximate cost per finished minute

How you would automate it

How you would improve quality

How you would reproduce the system for our clients**



Any third-party costs required for the challenge must be disclosed and approved before starting.



## HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with:



### "I BUILD AI."



Then answer:



**1. Show us the 3 most impressive AI automations or agents you've personally built.**



**2. Have you created a realistic AI video or voice clone? Show us examples you are permitted to share.**



**3. What have you actually built using OpenClaw, Hermes or comparable autonomous-agent technology?**



**4. What's the most complicated n8n, Make, API or automation workflow you've built?**



**5. If we gave you high-quality video and audio of someone, what technology stack would you investigate first to create a reusable video + voice clone, and why?**



**6. How would you minimize the ongoing cost of producing videos once the clone is built?**



**7. What's something involving AI you taught yourself in the last 90 days?**



**8. What monthly salary are you seeking in USD?**



**9. Are you available full-time and looking for a long-term position?**



Finally, put:



### DOMINATE



at the very end of your application.



You are welcome to use AI to help prepare your application.



**We're an AI company. We'd be surprised if you didn't.**



But don't let AI invent your experience.



If you say you built something, be prepared to **show it, explain it and demonstrate it.**



We're not looking for someone to complete a project and disappear.



### We're looking for someone we can invest in, keep busy, develop and work with for years.



If you're an AI builder looking for that kind of opportunity, **we want to hear from you.**

title: Short-Form Video Editor - TikTok, Reels & YouTube Shorts
description:
About the Role



Jim Penman is best known as the founder of Jim's Group.

This role focuses on Jim's personal brand, academic research, and upcoming book, Birth Rate Crisis.



His content covers topics including:

- Global fertility decline

- Epigenetics

- Dopamine sensitivity

- Mental health

- Family formation

- Human behaviour

- The rise and decline of civilizations

- Biohistory



The challenge is simple.



Take complex scientific and historical ideas and turn them into short videos that everyday people want to watch, share and debate.



What You'll Do

You will work with long-form podcasts, interviews and lectures.



Your job is to:

- Find the strongest moments without being given timestamps

- Identify hooks that can stop someone scrolling

- Turn long conversations into 45-90 second videos

- Edit for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts

- Add dynamic captions

- Add relevant B-roll and visual aids

- Use charts, graphics and images where they improve understanding

- Remove unnecessary pauses and sections

- Keep complex ideas understandable without changing their meaning



This is not simply a video-cutting role.



You need to understand what Jim is saying and identify what will interest an audience.



What We're Looking For



Short-form experience

You have edited TikToks, Reels or YouTube Shorts from long-form content.

Strong editorial judgement

You can watch a long interview and find the 60 seconds most likely to generate discussion.

Retention-focused editing



You understand hooks, pacing, captions, pattern changes and viewer retention.

Software skills

You can use Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut or similar software.

Interest in complex subjects

You are comfortable editing discussions about science, psychology, history and society.

You do not need to be an academic. You do need to understand the material before editing it.



How To Apply



Please include:

1. A link to examples of your recent short-form video work.

2. Your preferred editing software.

3. Your expected hourly or monthly rate.

4. Your normal turnaround time for one 45-90 second video.

5. Pick one video from your portfolio. In 2-3 sentences, explain why you think the edit works.



Important: Put the word "RABBIT" in the subject line of your application.

Applications without RABBIT in the subject line will not be considered.

title: Part Time Video Editor for Short Social Media Videos (Paid Per Video)
description:
We are My Style Mortgage, a mortgage company in Idaho, USA. We are hiring 1 or 2

editors for our video work. Because the team is small, the editors we pick will

get most of our videos.



What you will edit:

- Loan officer videos where they talk to the camera, usually under 2 minutes

- Screen recordings that need to become short explainer videos

- Some property videos made from photos and a voiceover



Every video needs:

- Vertical format (9:16) for
, Instagram and TikTok

- Mistakes, long pauses and dead air cut out

- Captions that match what is being said

- Our logo and brand colors

- Simple b-roll and music when it helps



How the work comes to you:

When a video is ready, we send you a link with the footage and written notes on

what we want. You upload the finished video to the same link. You have 48 hours

to finish each video. If a video is not done in 48 hours, we give it to another

editor.



Pay:

$15 per video, paid every week by PayPal or Payoneer.

We expect about [number] videos a month to start.



Software:

Use CapCut, Premiere Pro or any program you like, as long as the finished video

looks clean.



Nice to have:

Experience running Meta ads, or making ad videos and graphics. If you have run

ads under Meta's Special Ad Category for housing or credit, tell us.



How to apply:

1. Start your application with the word RIGBY.

2. Send links to 2 or 3 vertical videos you edited.

3. Tell us how many hours a week you can work.



We will pick a few people for a paid test. Each person edits the same video and

gets $15 for it.

title: Digital Revenue & Opportunities Researcher
description:
We are looking for an extremely resourceful, entrepreneurial, and internet-savvy person whose primary responsibility will be finding and validating new ways for our company to generate revenue online.



This is NOT a traditional virtual assistant position.



Your job is not simply to search YouTube, TikTok, Reddit, or Google and send us interesting videos or business ideas.



Your job is to FIND opportunities, RESEARCH them, VALIDATE them, and help us determine which ones are actually worth pursuing.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will continuously research digital and online revenue opportunities, including but not limited to:



• YouTube and content businesses

• YouTube clipping and short-form content

• Faceless social media accounts

• Affiliate marketing

• Digital products

• AI-powered businesses

• Lead generation

• Online service businesses

• Automation opportunities

• E-commerce

• Online marketplaces

• Emerging platforms and business models

• New trends that could potentially generate revenue



You should also be willing to discover opportunities we haven’t thought of yet.



RESEARCH & VALIDATION



Finding an idea is only the beginning.



For promising opportunities, you will research:



• How the business actually makes money

• Who the customers are

• Examples of people or companies successfully doing it

• Startup costs

• Software and tools required

• Competition

• Potential profit margins

• Time required to launch

• Estimated time to first revenue

• Scalability

• Automation potential

• Platform risks

• Legal or business risks

• Reasons the idea could fail



You should be naturally skeptical.



If someone online claims they are making $20,000 per month from a business model, we don’t automatically believe them.



We investigate it.



TESTING OPPORTUNITIES



The best ideas will move beyond research.



You may be asked to help us create small, inexpensive tests to determine whether an opportunity actually works.



Example:



Instead of simply telling us that a YouTube clipping business could make money, we may create an account, publish content, track the results, study monetization requirements, and determine whether the business deserves additional investment.



We believe in testing ideas instead of endlessly discussing them.



WEEKLY EXPECTATIONS



Each week you should be able to explain:



What opportunities did you research?



Which ones did you eliminate and why?



Which opportunities deserve further research?



Which opportunities should we test?



Which ONE opportunity do you believe currently has the greatest potential and why?



Your performance will NOT be measured by how many ideas you send us.



It will be measured by your ability to identify legitimate opportunities, eliminate bad ideas quickly, create intelligent experiments, and ultimately help us develop new sources of revenue.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be a great fit if you are:



• Entrepreneurial

• Extremely curious

• Resourceful

• Internet savvy

• Comfortable researching independently

• Comfortable using AI tools

• Familiar with YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and other digital platforms

• Able to understand basic business economics

• Analytical but creative

• Comfortable with spreadsheets and numbers

• Able to communicate research clearly

• Naturally skeptical of online “get rich quick” claims

• Someone who enjoys figuring out how businesses make money



Previous experience building online businesses, side hustles, content accounts, digital products, e-commerce businesses, or similar projects is highly valued.



We are more interested in how you THINK than having a perfect résumé.



APPLICATION TEST



Please do not send us a generic application.
 your CV and answers to 
 be considered, answer the following:



Find 3 legitimate online business opportunities that could potentially be launched with less than $1,000.



For each opportunity briefly explain:



1. What the business is

2. How it makes money

3. Estimated startup cost

4. How quickly it could realistically generate its first revenue

5. The biggest risk

6. Why you believe the opportunity is worth considering



Then rank all three opportunities.



Finally, give us a simple 30-day execution plan for your #1 choice.



We are looking for someone who thinks like an entrepreneur, not someone who simply searches Google.



LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



We are building multiple businesses and revenue streams.



If you consistently discover and help develop profitable opportunities, this position can grow significantly.



Our goal is to build a team that continuously discovers opportunities, tests them, launches the winners, and then builds systems and teams around the businesses that work.

Experience: 5+ Years Sales | 2+ Years Leadership



We are seeking a results-oriented Assistant Team Leader (ATL) to support, manage and scale our sales operations. Positioned as a TL-Track agent, this role has the opportunity to transition into a full Team Leader role upon vacancy or expansion.

About Haulla

We help small and mid-sized businesses across the U.S. find better, more affordable waste solutions tailored to their needs.



Responsibilities

title: Creative Producer for Game Advertising (Part Time, Long Term, Growing to Full Time)
description:
We are a US based creative agency producing advertising creative for mobile and PC game publishers. We concept, write, capture, edit, and deliver the video and static ads that run their user acquisition campaigns.



We are looking for a creative producer to take over three of our active game accounts and run them day to day. This is a creative role, not an administrative one. You will d
 what the ads say and why they will work, then drive the production team that builds them.



This starts at 20 hours per week. We have two larger engagements closing in the next quarter and this role grows to full time as they land. We are hiring now because we would rather find the right person early than rush later.



What You Will Do



Study each game and develop the creative angles we test. Write the scripts, the hooks, and the ad copy yourself.



Build shot lists for gameplay capture and brief our capture operator against them.



Brief and direct our editor, our motion work, and our AI video and image generation. Review what comes back, give clear notes, and push it to final delivery.



Manage versioning across platforms and aspect ratios and deliver on spec and on time.



Prepare a monthly creative plan for each account and keep the schedule moving.



What We Need



Three or more years producing advertising creative. Game, app, or entertainment experience preferred. Performance advertising experience matters far more than brand or corporate video work.



Excellent written English. You are writing scripts and ad copy, so this is the first thing we evaluate.



Real hands on experience with AI video and image generation in finished client work, not experiments. We use tools in the Higgsfield family along with Veo and ElevenLabs. If your stack is different we will bring you across.



Comfort reviewing edit and motion work in CapCut, Premiere, or After Effects. You do not have to be the finishing artist, but you need to spot problems and say what to fix.



Familiarity with gameplay capture. You should know what a clean plate is and what makes footage usable in an ad.



Availability for two or three scheduled calls per week during US Pacific morning hours. The rest of the work is async.



What We Provide



An editor, a capture operator, a social media manager, and a media buying partner already working on these accounts. Established processes and existing client relationships. You are stepping into a running operation.



Payment



Twice monthly via Wise or PayPal, your preference. Rate and hours both increase as our account load grows.



To Apply



Send us the following:



One ad or campaign you personally concepted and produced. What was the brief, what angle did you choose and why, and what were the results.

Links to three pieces of work you directed.

Which AI generation tools you have used in paid client work.

Your expected monthly rate.

Applications without the word Riftstone at the top will not be reviewed.

title: Remote Manual QA Tester / VA — Website & App Testing
description:
Company: 

Location: Remote

Primary focus: Manual testing, bug reporting, and user-experience quality



About the role



I’m looking for a careful, methodical QA tester to help improve Bellaura, a platform for creators and creative professionals.



Your job will be to use the platform from the perspective of different users, identify problems, document them clearly, and verify that fixes work. I need someone who goes beyond checking whether a button can be clicked and thinks about whether the full experience makes sense.



Strong written and spoken English is required. Clear written communication is especially important: your bug reports should help a developer understand and reproduce an issue without unnecessary back-and-forth.



What you’ll do

Test complete user journeys, including account creation, login, profiles, media uploads, discovery, events, messaging, and booking flows as available.

Check functionality and presentation across agreed desktop and mobile browsers, screen sizes, and user roles.

Test both normal behavior and edge cases, such as missing information, invalid inputs, repeated actions, interrupted flows, and different permission levels.

Write reproducible bug reports with steps, expected versus actual results, environment details, impact, and supporting screenshots or recordings.

Retest fixes, maintain regression checklists, and flag confusing wording, broken layouts, inconsistent behavior, and usability problems.

Who I’m looking for



You should have hands-on experience with manual website or app testing and be comfortable documenting your work in an issue tracker or structured task system.



You need patience, curiosity, attention to detail, and the ability to separate a reproducible defect from a suggestion or personal preference. You should keep testing records organized and communicate what is blocked, what has passed, and what still needs investigation.



Coding is not required. Experience with browser developer tools, automated testing, or Playwright is a plus. Testing must use approved accounts and data, with appropriate care for private information.



Additional skills I strongly prefer



QA testing is the priority for this listing, but ideally you also have experience in executive assistance, video editing, and photo editing.



I would prefer one versatile candidate who can contribute across multiple areas. Administrative organization and follow-through are particularly useful alongside testing, and candidates who can also produce good photo and video edits are especially interesting.



For the creative side of the role, my preference is to have photo and video editing handled by the same person.



How to apply



Please send an introduction in English describing your testing experience, the types of products you have tested, and the tools you use. Include one or two anonymized bug-report examples, or create a sample report that demonstrates how you document an issue.



Summarize your experience across all four areas and include editing portfolios if relevant. Also provide your time zone, weekly availability, earliest start date, and expected hourly or monthly rate.

s, arranging meetings, preparing proposals, following up on enquiries, and maintaining relationships with prospective and existing clients.

The Right Mindset

* Is willing to learn about debt collection and UCC’s international services



Why Join UCC?

* Market a professional service that helps businesses improve their cash flow

* Communicate with business owners and senior decision-makers

title: Producer | Founder-Led Content
description:
You've had this job before. You just never had the title.



You were the editor, the VA, the "content manager." But you were the one who actually ran the show. You built the process nobody asked for. You chased the founder for footage. You rebuilt the week around the session he missed. And when it went out late, YOU heard about it.



You can see the whole machine. You've just never been handed the keys.



I'm the founder. I'm the face. I'm the decision-maker. I am also, consistently, the bottleneck. I know it. I'm hiring you to fix it.



The Work



We're building a show: daily video content from me, turned into content everywhere my market lives, with paid promotion behind it. The system exists in my head (and in the process I run for my clients.) It does NOT (yet) exist on paper.



Job one is standing it up WITH me. 

Scheduled working sessions, you and I, pulling the loop out of my head and into a production you can run. 

You'll be in the room for the layout, not handed a manual afterward.



Job two is running it. 

You own the schedule. 

You get me in front of the camera. 

You drive the raw through edit, audit, approval, and launch, and you don't let it sit. 



I make the calls. 

You make sure the calls get made, on time, and executed.



Job three is earned: 

the loop gets tight enough that I only record and steer, 

and YOU run the whole show.



What can't be taught is HOW YOU'RE WIRED. 



You start things and you don't let go. 

A rough vision energizes you. 

A founder who's hard to pin down doesn't scare you. 



You've done this for someone else's face - and you were good at it.



The Offer



Direct access to the owner. A schedule that's yours to protect. Real authority over the production, starting day one. A show you helped design and then get to run. And a role that grows into showrunner if you earn it, because I'd rather promote the person who built it than hire over them.



To Apply



Tell me two things, briefly:



A time you turned someone's loose idea into a process that actually ran.

A time the person you depended on kept NOT delivering, and what you did about it.



In Closing



If you want to be told what to do each day, this isn't for you. 

If you need a finished SOP before you can move, this isn't for you. 

If what you really want is to be the strategist, this isn't for you either. (The decisions stay with me.)



But if you read the first ten lines and felt seen, you already know. 

Send it!

description:
Company: Bellaura

Location: Remote

Primary focus: Photo selection, editing, retouching, and gallery preparation



About the role



I’m looking for a skilled photo editor and retoucher to help prepare high-quality images for Bellaura’s photography and creative projects.



Our work includes fashion, editorial, portraits, headshots, events, and other client photography. I need someone who can maintain a refined, consistent visual style while reducing the time I spend selecting images, editing, retouching, and preparing galleries.



Strong written and spoken English is required. You should be able to understand detailed editing notes, ask useful questions, communicate clearly, and apply feedback consistently.



What you’ll do

Cull shoots thoughtfully, identifying strong expressions, poses, composition, and technical quality while removing duplicates and unusable frames.

Edit exposure, white balance, color, contrast, cropping, and overall image consistency across a gallery.

Retouch skin, clothing, backgrounds, distractions, and other details while preserving natural texture and the intended aesthetic.

Match reference images and established editing styles, using non-destructive workflows and following our color-management standards.

Organize files, maintain clear versioning, and prepare correctly sized, quality-checked exports for client delivery, websites, portfolios, and social media.

Who I’m looking for



You should be confident using Adobe Lightroom and Photoshop, with a portfolio that demonstrates both consistent batch editing and careful individual retouching.



I’m looking for good judgment—not simply heavy smoothing or applying the same preset to every image. You should understand natural skin tones, subtle cleanup, consistent color, and when an image needs additional attention.



Experience with fashion, beauty, editorial, portraits, or event galleries is especially relevant. You will need a computer and internet connection suitable for large RAW files and image collections.



Additional skills I strongly prefer



Photo editing is the priority for this listing, but ideally you also have experience in video editing, executive assistance, and manual website or app QA testing.



I would strongly prefer to combine photo and video editing in one role. Please highlight any experience editing reels, behind-the-scenes footage, interviews, or event videos.



Experience organizing creative projects, coordinating deliverables, or testing website features is also valuable. I’m interested in a versatile candidate, but strong photo-editing quality remains the main requirement for this post.



How to apply



Please send an introduction in English, several before-and-after examples you have permission to share, and a sample set showing consistency across multiple images. Explain your contribution and the tools you used.



Include video samples if available and summarize your experience across all four areas. Also provide your time zone, weekly availability, earliest start date, and expected hourly or monthly rate.
