title: Paid Media Specialist (Performance Marketing)
description:
Starting USD $1,000 - $1,400 / month | Full-time | Remote | Fast-track hiring | Hire by Sep 25 | Asia Time Zone



---



Are you a performance marketer who knows why the numbers moved, not just what they are?



This is a high-caliber, high-growth marketing team with ambitions to scale significantly further. They are adding paid media capacity — not to maintain what is running, but to push harder on what is already working and open up what is next.



Apply below to own real ad channels across Meta, TikTok, Google and more — with stable clients and active coaching in AI workflows.







---



[1] About Ally



Ally helps founders and leaders scale themselves before they scale their companies.



Founded by leaders who have scaled and operated 8-figure+ businesses, we partner with top operators and support clients including a NASDAQ-listed company.



We match Executive Partners (EPs) with fast-growing e-commerce and creative businesses to bring structure, clarity, and execution leverage — blending human judgment with modern AI systems.



We're not a traditional VA agency. We're a modern operating partner helping global teams run smarter and faster.



This role sits with one of our clients — a team that took a consumer health brand from zero to $100M USD. Built by operators who previously scaled a NASDAQ-listed company, Casetify, and Peak21, the brand crossed 8-figure revenue and 1M+ customers in under 36 months. You would work inside their marketing team, with Ally behind you.



---



[2] The Role



As an Executive Partner in paid media, you will own the performance of the ad channels we give you. You buy the media, watch the numbers every day, and tell the team what they mean and what to do next.



Leadership does not open the ad platforms. They read your report. That means your report has to be right every single day, and it has to come with a point of view, not just a set of figures.



For your first month or two you will bring your recommendations to the marketing lead for approval. Once you have shown you can read the numbers, you optimise on your own.



---



[3] What You'll Do



What you own:



- How your channels perform. Keep the channels assigned to you running, and grow them. That means managing the spend, creating and managing the ad accounts, setting up a replacement when one gets rejected, and flagging billing before a lapse stops our campaigns.

- The daily report. Build and maintain it across every funnel, and know why each formula works rather than just where to type the number. Leadership never opens the ad platforms, they read your report. It has to be right every day.

- How the agency content performs. Several agencies produce and post content for us. You get it live as ads on time, and you own how it does once it is running.

- Keeping the accounts alive. Our product category is high risk for ad and account bans. Monitor policy changes, spot the risk early, and act before a channel gets disrupted.

- Spotting things first. Flag underperformance, anomalies or opportunities before anyone asks.



What you work out:



- Analyze the data. Not just what happened, but why, and what to do next.

- Analyze creatives against performance and say what we should make more of.

- Research what is working for other brands and competitors. Not just ads: landing pages, messaging, offers and campaign strategies. Bring back specific things we should test, and draft the advertorials yourself (AI tools welcome).

- Look beyond your own assignment. Check what is happening on the other channels so you understand the whole picture.



What you run day to day:



- Launch ads at volume across Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, Reddit, Taboola and Google. Several hundred a week, mostly through bulk tools rather than one at a time.

- Work with our internal creative team and our external agencies on what is coming and when.

- Work directly with platform reps on rejections, approvals and questions.



---



[4] What Success Looks Like at 90 Days



- Your channels are growing. Spend and revenue up, ROAS held at target.

- You have a repeatable way to test creatives, and you are consistently finding and scaling the winners.

- Nothing has stopped. No campaign down because of a billing lapse, a rejected account, or a policy change you did not see coming.

- Your reports are trusted. Leadership d
 off them without going to check the platforms.

- You are bringing ideas, not just numbers. Things you found working for other brands that we should be testing.



---



[5] What We're Looking For



- You understand how paid ads work on at least one platform. Not just uploading. You know what to check, what to look at, and why. This is the one thing we cannot train from zero.

- Initiative. You see what needs doing and you do it. We can tell within a week who has this and who does not.

- You ask questions constantly. We would rather you ask ten times a day than stay quiet and hand in a report with mistakes in it.

- You treat the work as yours. The people who do well here push on something because they spotted the opportunity, not because someone asked them to.

- Strong attention to detail — accuracy in the data, polish in the presentation.

- Able to present data clearly — formatting, structure and visual clarity matter.

- Open to working on any platform — Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, Reddit, Taboola, Google. You may be strongest on one, but you will not get to stay there.

- Comfortable with bulk launch tooling like AdManage or Revealbot, or able to pick it up fast.

- Comfortable with spreadsheets, dashboards, and numbers.

- Familiarity with Google Sheets or Excel.

- Has used AI tools in their workflow (preferred, not required).

- Agency or in-house media buying experience is a plus. Time served matters less than knowing what you are looking at.



One thing this role is not: you will not be designing creatives. Our internal team and our agencies produce the assets. You shape what they make by telling them what the data says is working, and you will write advertorials yourself.



If you have read this far: open your video by naming which of our six platforms you have actually run ads on, and which you have never touched. Be honest. Nobody has all six, and we would rather know now.



---



[6] Schedule



5 days a week, 8am to 5pm Philippine time. Your two days off include one weekday, so one of your five working days falls on a weekend and the team always has coverage. We will confirm which days when we assign your channels.



If we ask you to cover a sixth day, that is overtime.



---



[7] What You'll Get



- Attractive starting rate and grow fast — starting at USD $1,000 - $1,400 / month

- Two weeks of one-on-one walkthrough training with the marketing lead

- Paid subscriptions to the tools you need

- Direct access to global founders and operators

- Mentorship and clear growth paths

- Real spend across six platforms on a brand that is scaling. That is a track record you can point at later.

- Fully remote setup

- Asia Time Zone

- Work that truly matters — every report you build drives real revenue decisions for global brands



---



[8] HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application here:







You will be asked to:

2. Record a short Loom video (2-3 mins) covering:

- Which of our six platforms you have actually run ads on, and which you have never touched

- Your relevant paid media or marketing experience

- Why you are interested in this role



In the video, also answer this:



Last 7 days, three ads:



- Ad A: $120 spent, 1 purchase, $95 revenue

title: Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Specialist — Australian Business + Philippine Remote Team



Remote | Philippines-based | Full-time | Australian business-hours overlap

Salary: Negotiable based on relevant experience



ABOUT ACQUA BATHROOMS



Acqua Bathrooms is an established Sydney bathroom retailer and importer, with wholesale brands Cee Jay Bathware and Indulge. We operate across eCommerce, showroom sales, warehousing and distribution, and are expanding into larger premises.



We’re looking for an experienced recruiter to take ownership of our hiring process, build our Philippine remote team and coordinate ongoing recruitment for our Australian operations.



You’ll work directly with our General Manager and Director. Your job is to bring us well-assessed finalists and keep recruitment moving through to onboarding.



YOUR IMMEDIATE PRIORITIES



Our initial remote hiring requirements are:



• Claims, Returns & Freight Recovery Specialist

• Inventory & Purchasing Coordinator

• Executive & Operations Assistant

• Shopify Product Catalogue & SEO Coordinator

• Shopify Website & Conversion Specialist



We already have applicants and assessment material for some positions. Your first step will be to review that pipeline, follow up with existing candidates and identify where additional sourcing is needed.



You’ll also coordinate Australian recruitment as vacancies arise, including showroom sales, customer service, administration, warehouse and driver positions. Our local managers will conduct practical assessments and final interviews where required.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN



• Clarify each vacancy’s responsibilities, requirements, budget and success measures with the hiring manager.

• Write targeted advertisements and source candidates through OnlineJobs.ph and relevant Australian recruitment channels.

• Screen applications and conduct initial phone or video interviews.

• Check relevant experience, communication, availability, salary expectations and suitability for the actual work.

• Coordinate practical assessments and have specialist work reviewed by the appropriate manager.

• Conduct reference checks with candidate consent.

• Present a small shortlist with evidence, strengths, concerns and a clear recommendation.

• Schedule final interviews and keep candidates updated.

• Coordinate approved offers, start dates and onboarding documents.

• Maintain one accurate recruitment tracker covering every vacancy, candidate stage, owner and next action.

• Build reusable interview guides, scorecards and onboarding checklists.



Final hiring decisions, salaries and offers remain subject to management approval.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



• Proven experience managing recruitment from sourcing through to onboarding.

• Demonstrated experience recruiting Philippine remote staff AND candidates for Australian employers.

• Ability to manage several different vacancies without losing track of follow-ups.

• Strong written and spoken English, including confidence interviewing Australian candidates.

• Experience using OnlineJobs.ph and Australian sourcing channels such as SEEK, Indeed or LinkedIn.

• Sound judgement when checking whether a candidate’s claimed experience matches their actual ability.

• Strong organisation and confidence using an applicant tracking system or a clear spreadsheet-based pipeline.

• Discretion when handling candidate and company information.



Experience recruiting for eCommerce, Shopify, inventory, retail, customer service or logistics roles will be particularly useful.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



In your first month, you will have reviewed the existing pipeline, agreed the hiring priorities, established a clear recruitment tracker and progressed suitable candidates through structured screening and assessment.



We value shortlist quality, reliable follow-through and successful starts. We expect you to flag problems early and bring recommendations without needing constant reminders.



HOW TO APPLY



Use the subject line: “Acqua Recruitment — [Your Name]”.



Please include your CV and answer these questions briefly:



1. Which Australian and Philippine roles have you personally recruited for? Give two recent examples, including your responsibilities and the outcome.

2. Which of our five immediate positions have you recruited for before?

3. How would you organise your first two weeks with us, including reviewing existing applicants?

4. How would you verify that a Shopify or inventory candidate can actually do the work?

5. Share an anonymised recruitment tracker or candidate assessment you created, if available. Remove names and confidential information.

6. What are your available working hours, earliest start date and expected hourly or monthly rate? Please specify the currency.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a brief practical recruitment exercise and interview.



We’re looking for someone who can build a dependable hiring process and support our business as it grows.

title: Senior Server / DevOps Specialist - Linux, Docker, Cloud Infrastructure
description:
We are looking for an experienced Server Administrator / DevOps Specialist to help us review, secure, document and optimize our server infrastructure.



This is not an entry-level role. We run live production systems for active clients, so we need someone who knows how to investigate infrastructure safely without disrupting service.



We are a technology company with custom software, kiosks, digital signage and cloud-hosted web applications.



TECH ENVIRONMENT

Linux (Ubuntu/Debian), Docker/containers, Nginx/Apache, MySQL/MariaDB, Node.js, WordPress, cloud/VPS hosting (AWS, DigitalOcean and others), APIs and custom web applications.



WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

- Audit our cloud servers and identify what is running on each one

- Map how our applications, APIs and databases connect to each other

- Review resource usage, backups and snapshot schedules

- Review firewall rules, access controls and SSL/certificate management

- Review monitoring and alerting coverage

- Help harden and secure live production servers

- Identify and safely retire unused or redundant infrastructure, only after dependencies are fully verified

- Help us build fully isolated staging/development environments so our developers can test and upgrade applications without any risk to production

- Document everything clearly for management and future developers



VERY IMPORTANT

We have live clients, so caution matters more than speed. You do not delete, restart, upgrade or modify anything simply because it looks old or unused.



Our standard process for any change is: backup, dependency check, risk review, approval, execution, then testing.



We want someone comfortable tracing indirect and hidden dependencies (configuration, integrations, scheduled tasks, storage, third-party services, container networking, etc.) before touching anything.



SKILLS WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Strong, current experience with Linux server administration, cloud/VPS hosting (AWS, DigitalOcean and similar), Docker, Nginx/Apache, MySQL/MariaDB, DNS, SSL, SSH, firewalls, backups/monitoring, WordPress server administration, Node.js and API-based applications, and production troubleshooting.



Bonus: Cloudflare, Nuxt.js, Portainer, and general digital-signage/kiosk device-management experience.



WHO WE WANT

Someone who thinks before touching production, can investigate an unfamiliar server methodically, documents their work, communicates clearly with non-technical management, explains risk in plain English, never guesses when evidence is missing, and can work independently. Comfortable using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT to move faster, but has the technical judgment to verify anything an AI recommends before acting on it.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include:

1. Your years of Linux/server administration experience

2. Your experience with major cloud providers (AWS, DigitalOcean, etc.)

3. Your experience with Docker

4. An example of a production environment you inherited and had to investigate from scratch

5. An example of how you safely retired an old server without breaking anything

6. Your experience cloning production applications into staging/dev environments

7. Your hourly or project rate

8. Your availability and how soon you can start



SCREENING QUESTION

A company has an old Linux server that appears unused, but nobody is sure whether other applications still depend on it. Before deleting that server, what exactly would you check? Please answer this in your application.



Start your application with the words: SERVER AUDIT

This confirms you read the complete posting.



POSITION TYPE

Project-based / freelance to start, with potential for ongoing part-time support. Looking to start immediately.

Remote | Philippines | 20–40+ hours per week



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an experienced Senior Video Editor to join the Clipfluence team.

But we're not looking for someone who can simply follow an edit.

We're looking for someone who can build one.

Someone we can give raw footage, a client brief and an outcome to, and trust them to make the creative decisions needed to turn it into something worth watching.

You'll work across long-form podcasts, premium YouTube videos, short-form content, trailers, promos and educational/business content.

One project might be a two-hour multicamera podcast. The next could be a highly produced YouTube video requiring B-roll, motion graphics and sound design. Then you might need to turn a long conversation into a 60-second trailer or find the strongest short-form moments within an episode.

We need someone who is comfortable doing all of it.

You'll have support and creative direction when needed, but we're hiring at a senior level because we want someone who brings ideas to an edit rather than waits for them.



ABOUT CLIPFLUENCE

Clipfluence is a video and podcast content agency working with businesses, creators and podcasts around the world.

For 7+ years, we've helped clients turn conversations, ideas and raw footage into content people actually want to watch.

We're a small, experienced team that cares deeply about the work we create. We don't believe great editing means adding as many effects, transitions or captions as possible. It's about understanding the content, the audience and what the edit actually needs.

Sometimes that means motion graphics, B-roll, music and sound design.

Sometimes it means knowing when to get out of the way and let a great moment breathe.

Our clients trust us with their content and their brands, and we're looking for another editor who takes that responsibility as seriously as we do.



WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING

There is no single "Clipfluence style."

Every client is different, and their content should feel like them, not like it came out of the same editing template.

You'll work across:

Long-form multicamera podcasts

Premium and technical YouTube videos

Educational and talking-head content

Podcast trailers and episode promos

Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts

Story-driven and emotional content

Business and industry-specific content

B-roll, motion graphics and sound-design-heavy edits

Simpler edits where the content needs room to breathe

Adaptability is a big part of this role.



WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

You'll be expected to take ownership of projects from raw footage through to the finished edit.



Your responsibilities will include:

- Editing long-form podcasts and YouTube videos

- Editing multicamera footage with purposeful angle changes

- Building strong openings, cold opens and episode intros

- Creating podcast trailers and episode promos

- Finding the strongest short-form moments within long recordings

- Making independent decisions around pacing, structure and storytelling

- Identifying where B-roll, graphics or supporting visuals strengthen the content

- Creating motion graphics and animated elements when needed

- Using music and sound design intentionally

- Cleaning audio and colour correcting footage

- Checking captions, spelling, graphics and on-screen text

- Organising projects and exporting content correctly

- Responding to feedback and completing revisions efficiently



Most importantly. You won't always be told exactly what to do. We want you to look at the content, understand what it needs and make creative decisions yourself.



WE DON'T MAKE CLIPS JUST TO MAKE CLIPS

Short-form is an important part of what we do, but we're not a clipping company.

A section of a podcast being 60 seconds long doesn't automatically make it a good Reel.

When selecting content, we want you thinking about the person watching it.

Why would they care about this?

Does it teach them something? Make them think? Make them laugh? Surprise them? Make them feel something? Give them something useful? Make them want to hear more?

You need to be comfortable watching long-form content, identifying the moments that actually matter and understanding why a particular moment deserves to become content. You won't always be handed timestamps. Choosing the right moment is part of the job.



PODCAST TRAILERS & PROMOS:

This is an important skill for this role.

You should be able to watch a conversation, understand what's interesting about it and determine how to make someone want to watch more.

Sometimes that means finding multiple moments throughout an episode and weaving them into a compelling 45–90 second story using pacing, music, sound design and visual editing.

Other times, the content calls for something much simpler.

Good editing isn't about doing the most. It's about knowing what the content needs.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

You can edit without constant direction

We don't want to tell you where every cut goes, what B-roll to use or where to add a graphic.

We'll give you context and feedback, particularly as you learn our clients, but we expect you to creatively solve the edit.

You understand what keeps people interested

We're happy to help refine your storytelling skills, but you should already have a strong instinct for what makes content interesting and what makes an edit drag.

You have strong technical skills

This isn't an entry-level editing position.

You should be comfortable with advanced editing, motion graphics, multicam footage, B-roll, audio, colour and sound design.

You're adaptable

Some projects need high-energy technical editing. Others need restraint.

You should be comfortable with both.

You notice the details

Bad cuts, spelling mistakes, inconsistent graphics, poor audio and sloppy exports shouldn't need someone else to point them out.



EXPERIENCE

Previous professional video editing experience is required.

Podcast-specific experience is valuable, but it isn't mandatory.

We'd rather hire an excellent YouTube editor who understands storytelling, pacing and visual communication than an experienced podcast editor who only knows how to switch camera angles and add captions.

If you've worked across podcasts, YouTube, creator content, educational content, documentaries or story-driven videos, we'd love to see it.



You should be comfortable with:

- Professional long-form editing

- Multicamera projects

- Short-form content

- Motion graphics

- B-roll and visual storytelling

- Audio cleanup and sound design

- Colour correction

- Captions and typography

- Masking, tracking and compositing when needed

- Large 4K files and long-form timelines



We don't care which editing software you use. We care about the finished product.

Your portfolio will ultimately matter more to us than which programs you know or the type of clients you've previously worked with.



Here are 2 examples of the style of content you MUST be able to create:



YouTube style - 

Podcast & Trailer style - 



THE KIND OF PERSON WE WANT

You care like it's your own

You take pride in what you create and want the finished piece to be something you're proud of.

You're independent

You don't need someone constantly checking what you're doing or telling you what comes next.

You're creative

You bring ideas and solutions rather than simply executing instructions.

You're reliable

If you commit to something, we need to be able to rely on you to deliver it.

You communicate

If you're unsure, ask. If there's a problem, tell us. If something could affect a deadline, communicate it early.

You're detail-oriented

We work with professional businesses and creators. Small mistakes matter, and we expect you to check your own work before submitting it.

You're open to feedback

Every client is different. Feedback and revisions are part of producing great work, and we expect you to handle them professionally.

You communicate clearly in English

Our clients are primarily Australian and American.

Strong written and spoken English is required.



YOUR SETUP

This is a remote position, so you need the equipment and internet connection to do the job properly.

Our projects regularly involve 4K footage, multiple cameras, long recordings, motion graphics and source files that can exceed 100GB.



You'll need:

- A computer capable of handling professional, technical editing

- Reliable high-speed internet

- Enough storage to comfortably manage large projects

- A reliable working environment during agreed hours

- Your computer and internet cannot be a bottleneck to doing the job.



ROLE DETAILS

Position: Senior Video Editor

Location: Remote, Philippines

Hours: Ideally 40 hours per week, although we're open to strong candidates looking for 20+ hours

Working hours: Initially approximately 9:00am–5:00pm Brisbane time, Monday to Friday

Starting rate: AUD $10–$15 per hour, depending on experience

Initial engagement: 3-month contractor/probationary period

There can be flexibility around working hours once we've established a strong working relationship.

Following the initial three months, there is an opportunity to move into a permanent full-time position if it's a good fit for both sides.

Compensation can also be reviewed based on demonstrated performance and contribution to the team.



WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US

We expect a lot from our editors, but we don't expect you to figure everything out alone.

You'll be joining an experienced editing team and will have support as you learn our clients, expectations and workflows.



You can expect:

- Clear briefs and client context

- Creative feedback and support

- A variety of projects and editing styles

- Work with established businesses, creators and podcasts

- Opportunities to develop your storytelling and technical skills

- A remote working environment with more flexibility as trust is established

- We don't expect you to know exactly how every Clipfluence client should be edited on Day 1.

- We do expect you to arrive with the editing ability, creative instinct and willingness to learn that allows us to get you there.



ABOUT WORKING AT CLIPFLUENCE

We're a small team, and we like it that way.

We care about the people we work with, the clients we work for and the content that leaves our hands.

Communication matters. Reliability matters. Quality matters.

And while we take the work seriously, we want Clipfluence to be a genuinely good place to work.

We're looking for someone who wants to become part of the team, learn our clients and create great work consistently rather than simply pick up another freelance editing gig.



HOW TO APPLY

If you've read this and thought "this sounds like me," we'd love to see your work.



Please send us:

- Your CV

- A short introduction about yourself and your professional editing experience

- 3–5 examples of your best work that demonstrate the range of what you can do

- If available, at least one premium or technically advanced YouTube edit

- If available, at least one trailer, promo or story-driven edit

- Your current availability and how many hours per week you're looking for



Please don't send us 20 examples. We'd rather see the 3–5 pieces you're most proud of.



Send your application to:

Monitoring and actioning the business inbox in real time, keeping our Trello boards and client pipeline up to date daily, managing client files and our event timeline system (TTO), preparing run sheets and event timelines often on tight turnarounds, following up with suppliers on quotes and deadlines, tracking invoices and payment schedules (no banking access), preparing and running the weekly ops meeting, managing and writing SOPs, and sending a concise weekly report covering what's done, what's overdue, and what needs a decision from Vicky.

Needs to be a person who take initiative and proactive.

Existing experience with Gmail, Studio Ninja, TTO, Calendly, Xero, MailerLite, Shopify, and Clockify are all teachable if you don't know them yet. Training will be provided on TTO and Studio Ninja. 



Hours and structure:

title: Cold Caller / Live Transfer Dialer – Commercial Cleaning (US Night Shift, Full-Time)
description:
Trust Elite Cleaning Solutions is a commercial and residential cleaning company in Los Angeles, California. We are hiring ONE full-time cold caller. Your only job: dial the businesses on our list, get the decision-maker on the phone, and transfer the call live to our sales team. That is it.



READ THIS FIRST: You must ALREADY know commercial cleaning. This means you have called for, sold for, or worked for a commercial cleaning or janitorial company, and you can talk about office cleaning, medical office cleaning, floor care, day porter service, and janitorial contracts like someone who has done it. If you have never worked in commercial cleaning, please do not apply. Applications from people with no commercial cleaning background will not be answered.



WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY

- Make 60+ outbound calls from a lead list we give you (property managers, medical offices, gyms, schools, warehouses)

- Get past the front desk and reach the person who d
 on the cleaning vendor (owner, office manager, facilities manager)

- Say one short line (we give you the script), then transfer the call live to our sales rep, who takes it from there

- Log every call in Notion in one line (we give you the format)

- Post your numbers in Slack at the end of your shift



What you will NOT do: selling, quoting, booking,
ing, customer service. You dial, you connect, you hand off.



HOURS

Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM US Pacific time (that is 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM Manila). Night shift only. Do not apply if you cannot work these hours.



PAY

$4.00 per hour, 40 hours per week ($160/week, about $690/month), paid weekly through OnlineJobs.ph EasyPay, PLUS a $4 bonus for every live transfer that our sales team turns into a booked walkthrough. A strong caller adds $40 to $80 a week in bonuses. This is serious, full-time work with a real daily target. Paid 3-day trial first (real calls, real leads, real pay), then full-time if you hit the numbers.



REQUIREMENTS

- REQUIRED: 1+ year working in or calling for a commercial cleaning / janitorial company (US clients preferred). You must know the industry, not just cold calling

- Outbound cold calling experience to US businesses (B2B, lead generation, appointment setting)

- Clear, confident spoken English. You will be talking to office managers and business owners

- Stable internet, quiet workspace, USB headset

- Comfortable with a daily target: 60 dials, 6+ live transfers to our sales team

- Available for the US Pacific night shift above



HOW TO APPLY (do all 4 or you will not be considered)

1. Put the word TRANSFER in the first line of your application

2. Name the commercial cleaning or janitorial company you worked for or called for, how long, and what you did there

3. Send a 60-second voice recording (Vocaroo link) of you calling an office and asking for the person who handles the cleaning vendor

4. Tell us how many outbound dials per day you made at your last calling job

About the role



I’m looking for a talented video editor to help turn our footage into polished, engaging content for Bellaura.



Our work includes fashion and editorial shoots, behind-the-scenes footage, creator interviews, events, and promotional content. I need someone with good taste, strong attention to detail, and the ability to turn a folder of footage into a finished piece—not just assemble clips.



Strong written and spoken English is required. You must be able to understand creative direction, identify strong moments in English-language footage, write accurate captions, and communicate clearly about revisions.



What you’ll do

Review and organize footage, select the strongest moments, and build a clear story or engaging sequence.

Edit short-form videos, reels, behind-the-scenes content, interviews, event recaps, and occasional longer pieces.

Handle pacing, music selection from approved sources, dialogue cleanup, sound design, color correction, and grading.

Create clean captions, titles, and simple graphics, and prepare versions for different formats and placements.

Maintain organized project files, incorporate feedback thoughtfully, and deliver consistent work on schedule.

Who I’m looking for



You should have a portfolio that demonstrates strong pacing, visual judgment, clean audio, and an understanding of when an edit needs energy versus restraint. Experience with fashion, beauty, lifestyle, events, or cinematic content is particularly relevant.



You should be confident in a capable editing workflow such as Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut. Your results and judgment matter more than the name of the software you use.



You will need a computer and internet connection that can reliably handle large media files.



Additional skills I strongly prefer



Video editing is the priority for this listing, but ideally you also have experience in photo editing, executive assistance, and manual website or app QA testing.



My strongest preference is to find one person who can handle both video and photo editing at a professional level. Lightroom and Photoshop experience would be particularly valuable.



Candidates who can also help with scheduling, organizing projects, following up with collaborators, or testing Bellaura’s features will receive additional consideration. Be clear about your strengths; you do not need to claim equal expertise in everything.



How to apply



Please send an introduction in English and three to five relevant video samples. Explain exactly what you handled in each example, including editing, color, audio, captions, or graphics.



Include photo-editing examples if available, the software you use, and a brief summary of your experience across all four areas. Also provide your time zone, weekly availability, earliest start date, and expected hourly or monthly rate.

title: Senior Sales Executive Remote | Full-Time | Uncapped Commission
description:
We’re looking for a driven, experienced sales professional who knows how to turn qualified opportunities into closed business. This is a results-focused role for someone who is confident leading sales conversations, uncovering customer needs, overcoming objections, negotiating terms, and asking for the close. You’ll work with prospective clients throughout the sales process and play a direct role in generating new revenue. If you’re competitive, self-motivated, and take ownership of your results, this role offers the opportunity to build a strong long-term career in sales with uncapped earning potential.



Compensation

Base Salary: $18,000–$20,400 USD annually

Commission: Uncapped, performance-based

Additional Incentives: Quarterly performance bonuses

Your total earnings will be directly influenced by your sales performance. High performers have the opportunity to significantly increase their income through commissions and bonuses.



What You’ll Do: 

As a Senior Sales Executive, you’ll take ownership of opportunities from initial qualification through to the final agreement.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Engage with qualified prospects and establish strong professional relationships

* Lead discovery conversations to understand customer goals, challenges, and priorities

* Identify opportunities where our solutions can provide meaningful value

* Deliver persuasive sales presentations and product or solution demonstrations

* Build customized proposals based on individual customer requirements

* Handle objections confidently and move opportunities forward

* Communicate with multiple stakeholders and decision-makers when required

* Negotiate commercial terms and guide prospects toward a purchasing decision

* Close new business and consistently work toward established revenue targets

* Maintain an accurate and up-to-date sales pipeline

* Document sales activity and customer information within the CRM

* Provide regular updates on pipeline activity, forecasts, and performance

* Work closely with internal teams to ensure a smooth customer handoff after the sale



What Makes You a Strong Candidate: 

We’re looking for someone who has already demonstrated that they can sell, negotiate, and close.

You’ll be a strong fit if you have:

* 2+ years of professional sales experience

* A proven history of meeting or exceeding sales targets

* Experience independently managing opportunities through the sales cycle

* A demonstrated ability to close deals of $5,000+ USD, or the equivalent in your market

* Experience working with CRM and sales pipeline systems

* Strong negotiation and objection-handling skills

* Excellent communication skills in English

* Confidence speaking with customers and decision-makers

* A disciplined, organized approach to managing your pipeline

* A strong sense of ownership and accountability for results

* The ability to work independently in a remote environment



The Personality We’re Looking For: 

Experience matters, but attitude matters just as much. The right person for this position is:

* Competitive — You enjoy setting ambitious goals and working toward them.

* Persistent — You don’t give up when a prospect raises an objection or a deal becomes challenging.

* Commercially minded — You understand that successful selling is about creating value, not simply delivering a sales pitch.

* Self-directed — You can manage your day, prioritize opportunities, and stay productive without constant supervision.

* Accountable — You take responsibility for your pipeline, activity, and results.

* Professional — You represent the company with confidence and credibility throughout every customer interaction.



Performance Expectations:

* Success in this position will be measured by your ability to consistently generate and close revenue.

* During your first year, strong performers are expected to work toward: 15–25+ qualified deals per quarter

* Building a sales pipeline of $50,000+ in recurring revenue

* Consistently meeting or exceeding assigned sales targets

* Developing lasting customer relationships

* Maintaining accurate pipeline forecasts and CRM records

* Contributing directly to overall company revenue growth

* Reaching potential total annual earnings of $30,000–$50,000+, including base salary and commissions

* Actual results and earnings will vary based on individual performance, sales volume, deal size, and other factors. 



What You’ll Receive:

* Competitive Base + Uncapped Earnings A reliable base salary combined with uncapped commission means there is no fixed ceiling on your sales earnings.

* Performance Bonuses Additional quarterly incentives are available for sales professionals who exceed performance targets.

* Fully Remote Work from anywhere in the world while collaborating with an international team.

* Career Growth Top performers will have opportunities to take on greater responsibility and advance within the organization.

* Training & Coaching Access ongoing sales training, coaching, and development designed to sharpen your skills and improve performance.

* Collaborative Environment Work alongside an international team with clear goals, defined expectations, and a results-oriented culture. 

Work Requirements:

* Full-time availability

* Ability to work primarily during U.S. Central Time (CT) business hours

* Reliable computer and professional home-office setup

* Stable, high-speed internet connection

* Strong written and spoken English

* Ability to work independently in a remote environment 



How to Apply: 

If you’re an experienced closer who is motivated by performance and wants an opportunity where your results directly influence your earning potential, we’d like to hear from you.



Send your application to: 

 subject: Senior Sales Executive Application 

Please Include:

* Your current resume or CV

* A brief overview of your sales experience

* Industries and types of products or services you have sold

* Your largest or most significant deals

* Examples of sales targets or quotas you have achieved

* Examples of complex sales you have successfully closed

* Your earliest available start date

* Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

* Eligibility: This opportunity is open to qualified applicants worldwide, excluding candidates based in the Philippines.

title: Creator & Affiliate Outreach Specialist – Textile Brand
description:
Creator & Affiliate Outreach Specialist



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | $600 USD/month



KIKI is a fast-growing U.S. fashion fabric company, and we are aggressively expanding our Creator & Affiliate Program.



We are looking for one exceptional person to help us identify, contact, recruit, and build relationships with high-quality creators and influencers.



This is not a basic VA position and it is not a mass-outreach job.



Your job is not simply to send as many messages as possible. Your job is to find the right people, understand them, communicate with them naturally, and bring strong creators into the KIKI Creator Program. 



WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



You will:



* Research fashion, sewing, cosplay, DIY, design, lifestyle, fashion designers, custom designers and other relevant creators

* Identify creators who genuinely fit the KIKI brand

* Analyze their content, audience, engagement, style, and potential

* Personally reach out through Instagram, TikTok,
, or other channels

* Write personalized outreach instead of copy-and-paste messages

* Follow up consistently

* Answer questions and handle objections

* Qualify interested creators

* Help onboard strong creators into our affiliate program

* Keep track of outreach, responses, applications, and results

* Continuously improve outreach based on performance





Your performance will eventually be measured by:



Creator quality → response rate → qualified creators recruited → affiliates activated → affiliates generating sales → revenue generated. 



THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



This role requires very strong judgment and communication skills.



You should be able to look at an Instagram or TikTok account and quickly understand:



* Is this creator actually a good fit for KIKI?

* Does her audience match our customer?

* Is her engagement real?

* Does she actually influence her audience?

* What would make her interested in KIKI?

* What should we emphasize when contacting her?

* How should we communicate with her?

* Should the approach feel feminine, casual, professional, playful, fashion-forward, premium, etc.? 



Most of the creators we communicate with are women in fashion, sewing, design, cosplay, and creative industries.



Because of this, you must have a natural understanding of:



Fashion. Aesthetics. Style. Social media. Female-focused communication. Brand presentation.



We need someone who understands how to communicate woman-to-woman / human-to-human, rather than sounding like a corporate salesperson.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF:



Do not apply if your experience is mainly:



* Generic customer support

* Data entry

* Mass cold
ing

* Copy-and-paste outreach

* Sending hundreds of identical DMs

* Following instructions without being able to make decisions independently



Customer service experience is useful, but customer service alone is not enough.



We need someone who can think, research, judge, communicate, persuade, and make decisions independently. 



Strong written English is mandatory.



Experience in any of these areas is highly preferred:



Influencer outreach, creator partnerships, affiliate marketing, social media, fashion, beauty, ecommerce, PR, sales, relationship management, or customer communication.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



This is a performance-based role.



We do not care about someone being "busy" for eight hours.



We care about results.



The first 30 days will be a paid performance trial.



Compensation: $600 USD/month full-time.



Additional bonuses and salary increase may be added based on measurable performance. It all depends on you.



IMPORTANT — HOW TO APPLY



We expect many applications.



If you do not follow every instruction below, your application will not be reviewed.



At the very top of your application, write:



KIKI CREATOR TEAM



If this phrase is missing, the application will automatically be rejected. 



1. INTRODUCE YOURSELF



Write a short, casual introduction.



We do not want a professional cover letter.



Write the way you would naturally communicate with another person.



If your introduction sounds extremely corporate, robotic, or obviously AI-generated, we will not continue reviewing the application.



2. TELL US ABOUT YOUR RELEVANT EXPERIENCE



Tell us specifically about any experience you have with:



* Influencer outreach

* Creator partnerships

* Affiliate marketing

* Sales

* Fashion

* Social media

* Customer relationships

* Ecommerce

* PR



Be honest.



If you do not have direct experience in one of these areas, say so. Lack of direct affiliate experience will not disqualify you if you demonstrate exceptional judgment and communication skills.



3. FIND 5 POTENTIAL KIKI CREATORS



Find 5 real Instagram or TikTok creators who you believe could become strong KIKI affiliates.



For each one, provide:



Creator username:

Platform:

Why you selected her: 1–2 sentences.



We care significantly more about why you selected someone than follower count.



4. WRITE AN OUTREACH MESSAGE



Choose one of the five creators.



Write the exact first message you would personally send her on behalf of KIKI.



Do not write generic outreach such as:



“Hi! We love your content! We’d love to collaborate. Join our affiliate program and earn 10%.”



That would not meet our standard. 



Our communication with creators should feel:



Warm. Casual. Personal. Natural. Friendly. Human.



KIKI CREATOR PROGRAM — CONTEXT FOR YOUR TEST



Before completing the next section, you need to understand what you would actually be offering creators.



KIKI is a U.S. fashion fabric brand serving:



* Sewing enthusiasts

* Fashion designers

* Costume makers

* Cosplayers

* Small fashion brands

* DIY creators

* Other creative customers



The primary goal of your outreach is to recruit strong creators into the KIKI Creator Program. 



You should not pitch every creator the same way.



A sewing creator with 8,000 highly engaged followers might require a completely different approach from a general fashion creator with 100,000 followers.



Your job is to understand the person before d
 how to approach her.



LEVEL ONE — AFFILIATE



Everyone starts here.



Affiliates receive:



* 10% commission on eligible referred sales

* 10% off for their audience on their first KIKI purchase

* Their own personal affiliate link

* Their own discount code

* Access to Win Your Fabric Back

* $100 KIKI store credit after reaching $2,000 in lifetime referred sales



Joining the affiliate program is free. 



WIN YOUR FABRIC BACK



A creator may purchase at least $80 of KIKI fabric.



If she then generates $300 in referred sales within 30 days after receiving the fabric, she receives $80 back as KIKI fabric credit.



This is optional.



It gives creators an opportunity to earn their initial fabric investment back instead of KIKI automatically sending free fabric to every new affiliate. 



LEVEL TWO — PROVEN AFFILIATE



A creator becomes a Proven Affiliate after generating:



$8,000–$24,999 in referred sales during a rolling 90-day period.



They receive:



* Everything from Affiliate level

* $250 KIKI fabric credit when they first reach $8,000

* Occasional surprise fabric gifts

* More opportunities to receive fabric and create content 



LEVEL THREE — KIKI AMBASSADOR



A creator becomes a KIKI Ambassador after generating:



$25,000+ in referred sales during a rolling 90-day period.



Ambassadors receive:



* 15% commission

* Monthly KIKI fabric credit while qualifying

* Early access to new fabric launches

* Surprise fabric gifts and packages

* Direct communication with the KIKI team

* Support, ideas, and feedback designed to help their content perform better 



Creator levels are based on their previous 90 days of performance.



Creators can move up as their sales increase and may move down if performance decreases.



THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS ROLE



You are not simply sending affiliate invitations.



Before contacting a creator, we expect you to think about:



* Who is this creator?

* What does she make?

* Who follows her?

* Why does her audience trust her?

* Does she already sew or use fabric?

* Which KIKI products could fit her content?

* What would genuinely interest her about our program?

* Which program benefit should you emphasize?

* What communication style fits her personality?

* Is she commercially valuable?

* Is she even worth contacting?



We want the creator to feel:



“They actually looked at my content.”



Not:



“This company sent the same message to 5,000 people.” 



APPLICANT TEST



For each scenario below, tell us:



1. Would you contact this person? Why or why not?

2. What would be your main hook?

3. Which part of the KIKI program would you emphasize?

4. Write the exact first message you would send.

5. If appropriate, write a follow-up message.



We want different approaches for different people.



SCENARIO 1 — SEWING MICRO-CREATOR



She has 9,000 Instagram followers.



She makes her own dresses and regularly posts sewing tutorials.



Her Reels typically receive 5,000–20,000 views.



Her followers frequently ask where she purchases her fabrics.



Her aesthetic is feminine and polished.



How would you approach her? 



SCENARIO 2 — LARGE FASHION CREATOR



She has 180,000 followers and produces beautiful fashion content and photography.



However, she rarely sews.



She mainly styles finished clothing and occasionally talks about independent designers.



Would you pursue her for the KIKI Affiliate Program?



If yes, explain your approach.



If no, explain why. 



SCENARIO 3 — COSPLAY CREATOR



She has 38,000 TikTok followers.



She creates elaborate costumes and frequently shows her construction process.



Some of her videos receive more than 300,000 views.



Her communication and content style is colorful, energetic, casual, and fun.



Write an outreach message that fits her personality and audience, rather than sounding like a corporate
. 



SCENARIO 4 — SMALL FASHION DESIGNER



She has 14,000 followers and owns a small clothing brand.



She regularly purchases fabric because she makes and sells dresses.



She doesn’t create many sewing tutorials, but her followers are interested in fashion entrepreneurship and garment design.



How would you position the KIKI Creator Program to her? 



SCENARIO 5 — CREATOR ASKS FOR FREE FABRIC



You contact a sewing creator with 45,000 highly engaged followers.



She replies:



“I would love to collaborate! Can you send me 10 yards of fabric for free and I can post something?”



KIKI does not automatically provide free fabric to new affiliates.



Write your response.



Your goal is to maintain her interest and explain the opportunity without sounding cheap, defensive, robotic, or dismissive. 



SCENARIO 6 — SHE DOESN’T LIKE AFFILIATE PROGRAMS



The creator replies:



“Thank you, but I normally don’t do affiliate links.”



Write your response.



Do not aggressively pressure her.



Show us how you would continue the conversation and determine whether there might still be an opportunity. 



SCENARIO 7 — NO RESPONSE



You find a creator who appears to be an excellent fit for KIKI.



You send your first message.



Five days later, she has not responded.



Write:



Follow-Up #1



Follow-Up #2



Then tell us when you would stop contacting her and why. 



SCENARIO 8 — WHO WOULD YOU PRIORITIZE?



You only have enough time to contact two creators today.



Creator A

250,000 followers

0.5% engagement

General fashion



Creator B

18,000 followers

6% engagement

Sewing and dressmaking



Creator C

70,000 followers

3% engagement

Beauty and lifestyle



Creator D

11,000 followers

8% engagement

Cosplay and costume construction



Choose only two.



Explain why you chose them and why you did not prioritize the other two. 



WHAT WE ARE EVALUATING



There is no single perfect answer.



We are evaluating your:



* Judgment

* Taste

* Research ability

* Communication skills

* Persuasion

* Attention to detail

* Understanding of creators

* Understanding of female-focused communication

* Ability to personalize

* Commercial judgment

* Ability to build relationships

* Ability to think independently



We care much less about whether your English sounds perfectly formal.



We care much more about whether you understand people.



Do not use generic AI-generated answers. Even if eventually you can use of course. Now we want to see your personal judgement.



If every message sounds identical, overly polished, corporate, or disconnected from the person described, your application will not move forward.

The main focus is helping the clinic turn warm enquiries into booked appointments through thoughtful follow-up, good conversations and good rapport.



We're looking for someone who feels comfortable speaking with Australian customers, knows how to keep a conversation natural, and can confidently help people move forward without sounding scripted or overly salesy.



Dental experience is definitely helpful, but strong communication and sales instincts matter more. The clinic is happy to train the right person on their services, systems and dental terminology.



What you'll be doing



∙ Follow up with warm leads and patient enquiries

∙ Speak with potential patients over the phone and help turn enquiries into appointments

∙ Follow up with people who may not be ready to book straight away

∙ Answer basic questions and help patients feel comfortable taking the next step

∙ Handle common objections in a natural and helpful way

∙ Keep lead notes and follow-ups organised

∙ Work closely with the clinic team on appointment availability, services and current offers



We'd love to hear from you if you have



∙ Strong experience in sales, lead conversion, appointment setting or lead generation

∙ Ideally 5+ years of relevant experience

∙ Experience speaking with Australian customers or supporting Australian businesses

∙ Confident spoken and written English

∙ A warm, conversational phone manner

∙ Good rapport-building and listening skills

∙ Confidence handling objections without sounding pushy

∙ The ability to work independently and stay on top of follow-ups



Nice to have



∙ Previous dental or healthcare experience

∙ Experience booking appointments

∙ Familiarity with GoHighLevel (GHL) or similar CRM systems

∙ Experience working with patient or healthcare leads



Don't worry if you haven't worked in dental before. For this role, we're much more interested in finding someone who is naturally good with people, confident in sales conversations and willing to learn the dental side.



Working Hours



This will start as a flexible, part-time role, at approximately 10 (or more) hours per week.

We work with Australian businesses looking for great people they can build long-term working relationships with.

This role is part project manager, part brand manager, and part personal assistant to the creator. Your job is to make sure nothing falls through the cracks — deadlines, contracts, samples, content plans, posting schedules, brand communications, and follow-ups.

You will work closely with:

-The creator

-Video editor(s)

-Bookkeeper

-Chief of Staff



This role will start part-time with the intention to scale to full-time within ~3 months, depending on workload and performance.



JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:

-Content Planning & Production Management

-Create and manage weekly and daily content schedules for:

-TikTok Shop product videos

-Personal brand content

-Organize filming days by content type (e.g., skincare days, makeup days, fashion days)



Assign due dates to:

-Raw footage

-Edited videos

-Posting deadlines



Ensure editors receive content on time and deliver edits on schedule

-TikTok Shop Sample & Deadline Tracking

Monitor TikTok Shop backend for:

-Sample requests

-Accepted samples

-Video due dates



Track:

-Products received

-Videos still pending

-Extensions (when needed)

title: Airbnb Operations and Video Editing
description:
# Virtual Assistant – Airbnb Operations and Video Editing



M3 Property Services is a growing serviced-accommodation and property-management company based in Kent, United Kingdom.



We manage multiple short-term and medium-term rental properties through Airbnb, Booking.com and direct bookings. We are looking for a reliable, proactive and highly organised Virtual Assistant to become a long-term member of our team.



This is not a standard fixed-hours position. The working hours will be flexible and spread across different parts of the day to support guests, cleaners and property operations during UK hours.



## Working arrangement



* Approximately six working hours per day.

* Hours will be distributed between the morning, afternoon and evening.

* You will not normally work six consecutive hours.

* You must be able to check the business at agreed times throughout the day.

* Some weekend availability will be required.

* You must respond quickly during your agreed coverage periods.

* The owner will provide cover during agreed gaps and outside your scheduled hours.

* Exact working times and days will be agreed with the successful applicant.

* Salary is negotiable depending on experience, availability and ability.



This position requires flexibility, but it does not mean being available every minute of the day. We want somebody reliable who can provide consistent coverage at the times when guests and operations require attention.



## Main responsibilities



### Guest communication and booking management



* Monitor and respond to Airbnb, Booking.com and direct-booking messages.

* Communicate with guests in clear, natural and professional English.

* Review the booking calendar several times throughout the day.

* Follow every guest through the complete booking journey.

* Monitor upcoming arrivals, guests currently staying and upcoming departures.

* Check that guests have received all required check-in, parking and property information.

* Follow up on missing guest details and unanswered questions.

* Handle straightforward guest questions independently.

* Recognise urgent problems and escalate them immediately.

* Keep booking information and guest records accurate.

* Assist with enquiries, availability checks and direct-booking quotes once trained.

* Help manage damage deposits and guest documentation once trained.



### Cleaning coordination



* Check the booking calendar every morning.

* Create and send the correct daily and upcoming cleaning schedules.

* Ensure cleaners know which properties require cleaning.

* Confirm that cleaning jobs have been accepted and completed.

* Follow up immediately if a cleaner has not responded.

* Record and report cleaning problems, damages and missing items.

* Keep future cleaning schedules accurate when bookings change.



### Maintenance and property administration



* Update and manage the maintenance tracker.

* Follow up with cleaners, contractors and maintenance workers.

* Ensure outstanding maintenance tasks are not forgotten.

* Record new property issues accurately.

* Keep property information, access instructions and operational documents updated.

* Escalate urgent maintenance problems immediately.

* Monitor and organise relevant company
s.

* Keep spreadsheets, calendars and trackers accurate.



### Financial and reporting support



Once trained, responsibilities may also include:



* Helping categorise property transactions.

* Updating property income and expense information.

* Assisting with monthly property profit-and-loss spreadsheets.

* Checking booking figures and property performance.

* Producing daily and weekly operational reports.

* Highlighting anything incomplete or requiring the owner’s attention.



### Video editing and content support



* Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok and other social platforms.

* Turn supplied video clips, voiceovers and ideas into engaging content.

* Add captions, hooks, music, B-roll and suitable transitions.

* Use CapCut, Canva or similar editing software.

* Complete video edits within agreed turnaround times.

* Make requested changes promptly.

* Help organise property and business content.



## Essential experience



Applicants must have:



* Previous experience working with Airbnb or within the short-term-rental industry.

* Practical experience using Booking.com.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Experience communicating with guests or customers.

* Strong organisational and time-management skills.

* The ability to follow checklists and repeat processes consistently.

* Good knowledge of Google Sheets, Google Drive and WhatsApp.

* Some previous video-editing experience.

* A reliable computer and internet connection.

* A backup plan for internet or power interruptions.

* Availability across agreed UK morning, afternoon and evening periods.

* The ability to work independently without constant supervision.



Experience with PriceLabs, property-management systems, direct bookings or serviced accommodation will be advantageous.



## Personal qualities



We are looking for somebody who is:



* Honest and trustworthy.

* Quick to respond.

* Accurate and attentive to detail.

* Comfortable asking questions when genuinely necessary.

* Proactive enough to notice missing information or potential problems.

* Able to take ownership rather than waiting for every instruction.

* Calm and professional when dealing with guest problems.

* Willing to learn new systems and improve.

* Interested in building a stable, long-term working relationship.

* Flexible as the business and property portfolio grow.



Training, checklists and standard operating procedures will be provided. We do not expect you to know everything immediately, but we do expect effort, honesty, consistency and a genuine willingness to learn.



## Paid trial



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid seven-day trial.



The trial may include:



* Reviewing a sample booking calendar.

* Producing a cleaning schedule.

* Responding to example guest messages.

* Handling a mock guest problem.

* Updating a maintenance tracker.

* Following a daily operational checklist.

* Editing a short-form video.

* Producing an end-of-day report.



Successful completion of the trial does not depend on knowing our entire business. We will assess communication, accuracy, initiative, reliability, availability and ability to follow instructions.



## How to apply



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your expected monthly salary for this working arrangement.

3. Your previous Airbnb and Booking.com experience.

4. The number of properties or listings you have previously helped manage.

5. The exact responsibilities you performed in your previous role.

6. Your availability during UK hours, including mornings, evenings and weekends.

7. An example of a difficult guest or operational problem you resolved.

8. Links to two short-form videos you have edited.

9. Details of the software and systems you have used.

10. Details of your internet connection and backup arrangements.

11. Your earliest possible start date.

12. A link to a 60–90 second video introducing yourself in English.



Please begin your application with the words **“Kent Property Operations”** to confirm that you have read the complete job description.



Applications without relevant Airbnb or Booking.com experience, a video introduction and an expected salary will not be considered.

title: Remote Admissions Coordinator – U.S. Healthcare
description:
Remote Admissions Coordinator – U.S. Healthcare



Abria Detox is a Minnesota-based withdrawal management facility providing 24/7 care to individuals seeking help with substance use and withdrawal.



We are looking for a reliable and experienced Remote Admissions Coordinator to join our team. This person will help manage our overnight admissions process by answering calls, assisting prospective patients, scheduling admissions, verifying insurance, maintaining accurate bed availability, and collecting patient payments.



This is a full-time, long-term remote position supporting a U.S.-based healthcare facility.



Work Schedule



Monday through Friday

11:00 PM – 7:00 AM U.S. Central Time (CT)

40 hours per week



This is an overnight U.S. shift. You must be available and actively working during the entire scheduled shift.



Please only apply if you are comfortable consistently working these hours.



Primary Responsibilities



* Answer incoming admissions calls promptly and professionally

* Respond to missed calls, voi
s, and admission inquiries

* Speak with prospective patients, family members, hospitals, treatment programs, and referral sources

* Collect patient demographic, clinical screening, and insurance information

* Conduct initial phone screenings using our established admissions process

* Schedule patient admissions and maintain an accurate appointment schedule

* Confirm appointments and follow up with scheduled patients

* Follow up with missed or cancelled admissions

* Verify insurance eligibility and benefits

* Contact insurance companies and use payer portals to obtain benefit information

* Determine deductibles, copays, coinsurance, and other patient financial responsibilities

* Explain estimated financial responsibility to patients when appropriate

* Collect private-pay balances, deductibles, and other required patient payments

* Maintain an accurate and up-to-date bed board

* Confirm bed availability before scheduling admissions

* Update bed availability as patients are admitted, discharged, scheduled, or cancelled

* Coordinate with our on-site nursing and clinical teams regarding admissions and bed availability

* Enter patient information accurately into our EHR and other systems

* Maintain detailed documentation of calls, insurance verification, payments, scheduling, and admission activity

* Escalate urgent clinical or admission issues to the appropriate on-site staff

* Protect confidential patient information and follow HIPAA requirements



Qualifications



* Previous U.S. healthcare experience required

* Experience in healthcare admissions, intake, patient access, insurance verification, medical scheduling, or a similar position strongly preferred

* Experience verifying U.S. medical insurance eligibility and benefits

* Familiarity with Medicaid and commercial insurance preferred

* Comfortable contacting U.S. insurance companies and using payer portals

* Comfortable discussing deductibles, copays, coinsurance, and private-pay costs with patients

* Comfortable collecting payments over the phone

* Strong spoken and written English

* Excellent telephone communication and customer service skills

* Strong computer and data-entry skills

* Able to manage multiple calls, patients, and tasks while maintaining accuracy

* Highly organized, reliable, and detail-oriented

* Able to work independently with minimal supervision

* Familiarity with HIPAA and U.S. healthcare privacy requirements

* Behavioral health, mental health, substance use disorder, detox, or addiction-treatment experience is strongly preferred



What We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone who is compassionate, professional, organized, and dependable.



Many people contacting Abria Detox are seeking treatment during a difficult time. You must be able to communicate calmly and professionally with prospective patients and their families while gathering the information necessary to determine the next steps in the admissions process.



Accuracy is extremely important. Insurance must be verified correctly, appointments must be scheduled properly, payments must be collected when required, and our bed board must always reflect our actual availability.



We want someone who takes ownership of the admissions process. If someone calls looking for treatment, we expect you to assist them, gather the necessary information, complete the required steps, schedule them when appropriate, document the interaction, and follow up when necessary.



Compensation



Compensation will depend on experience.



Higher compensation may be considered for candidates with significant experience in:



* U.S. healthcare admissions or patient access

* Insurance verification

* Behavioral health or substance use disorder treatment

* Detox or withdrawal management

* Medicaid and commercial insurance

* Medical billing or revenue cycle management



This is a long-term position with opportunities for increased responsibility and compensation based on performance.



How to Apply



Please include “ABRIA ADMISSIONS” at the beginning of your application so we know you read the entire posting.



Please answer the following questions:



1. How many years of U.S. healthcare experience do you have?

2. Have you worked in healthcare admissions, intake, patient access, or medical scheduling? Please explain.

3. Have you worked for a behavioral health, mental health, substance use disorder, detox, or addiction-treatment organization?

4. What experience do you have verifying U.S. medical insurance eligibility and benefits?

5. Which U.S. insurance companies and payer portals have you worked with?

6. Are you comfortable calling U.S. insurance companies to verify benefits?

7. Are you comfortable discussing deductibles, copays, coinsurance, and patient financial responsibility?

8. Are you comfortable collecting payments from patients over the phone?

9. Which EHR, CRM, scheduling, or healthcare systems have you used?

10. Are you comfortable handling a high volume of incoming and outgoing calls?

11. Are you able to consistently work Monday through Friday from 11:00 PM to 7:00 AM U.S. Central Time? Please answer YES or NO.

12. Please briefly describe your previous healthcare admissions or patient intake experience.



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of the Abria team and helping us provide a professional, responsive, and efficient admissions experience for every patient and referral source.
